war: nagsiring hi Laban, “Matuod gud nga akon ka kalugaringon nga unod ug dugo.” Nagpabilin didto hi Jacob sulod hin usa ka bulan.
en: Then Laban said to him, “You are my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,

war: May-ada hi Laban duha nga mga anak nga kababayen-an; ginngaranan nga Lea an magurang ngan Raquel an manghod.
en: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

war: Maghusay an mga mata ni Lea kundi maupay an tindog han lawas hi Raquel ngan matahum hiya.
en: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.

war: Binmaton hi Laban, “Gabay ko pa hiya ighatag ha imo kay ngadto hin iba nga tawo; pabilin dinhe upod ha akon.”
en: Laban said, “It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me.”

war: Sanglit naghatag hi Laban hin kombite hin pagkasal ngan gindapit niya an ngatanan.
en: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.

war: Kundi hito nga gab-i, diri hi Raquel, kundi hi Lea an gindara ni Laban ngadto kan Jacob ngan nakighilawas ha iya hi Jacob.
en: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.

war: (Iginhatag ni Laban kan Lea nga iya anak nga babaye hi Zilpa nga iya oripon nga babaye sugad nga iya surugoon.)
en: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.

war: Binmaton hi Laban, “Diri ini batasan dinhe nga ipaasawa an manghod nga anak nga babaye una han magurang.
en: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.

war: (Iginhatag ni Laban kan Raquel nga iya anak nga babaye hi Bilha nga iya oripon nga babaye sugad nga iya surugoon.)
en: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.

war: Sanglit iginhatag niya hi Bilha ngadto han iya bana, ngan nakighilawas ha iya hi Jacob.
en: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,

war: Nagburod hi Bilha ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin usa nga lalake.
en: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

war: Nagburod liwat hi Bilha ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin ikaduha nga lalake.
en: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

war: Niyan nag-anak hira Zilpa ngan hi Jacob hin usa nga lalake.
en: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

war: Nagsiring hi Lea, “Nagin palaran ako”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya nga Gad.
en: Then Leah said, “What good fortune!” So she named him Gad.

war: Nag-anak liwat hira Zilpa ngan hi Jacob hin usa pa nga lalake,
en: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

war: Ginbaton han Dyos an pag-ampo ni Lea, ngan nagburod hiya, ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin ikalima nga lalake.
en: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

war: Nagburod na liwat hi Lea ngan nag-anak hira ngan hi Jacob hin ikaunom nga anak nga lalake.
en: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

war: Ha orhe na nag-anak hiya hin usa nga babaye nga iya ginngaranan nga Dina.
en: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

war: Niyan nahinumdom an Dyos kan Raquel; binmaton niya an iya pag-ampo ngan ginhimo niya nga magkamay-ada hiya mga anak.
en: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.

war: Tagan pa unta ako han Ginoo hin lain pa nga anak nga lalake”; sanglit iya ginngaranan hiya nga Jose.
en: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the Lord add to me another son.”

war: Sumati ako han imo mga suhol ngan pagbabaydan ko ini.”
en: He added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”

war: Binmaton hi Laban, “Nauyon ako. Bubuhaton ta sumala han imo siring.”
en: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”

war: Hinsabtan liwat ni Jacob nga diri na makisasangkayon ha iya hi Laban sugad han una.
en: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.

war: Sanglit nagpatugon hi Jacob ngadto kanda Raquel ug Lea nga tapoon hiya nira didto han uma diin nakadto an iya mga panon.
en: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.

war: Maaram man kamo nga duha nga nagkabudlay ako ha bug-os ko nga kusog para han iyo amay.
en: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,

war: Ginkuha han Dyos in mga panon tikang han iyo amay ngan iginhatag ini ha akon.”
en: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.

war: Naghimangraw ha akon dida han akon inop an anghel han Dyos ngan nagsiring, ‘Jacob!’ Binmaton ako, ‘Aadi akon.’
en: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’

war: Ginlipat ni Jacob hi Laban pinaagi hin diri niya pagpahibaroa ha iya nga tilakat hiya.
en: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.

war: Paglabay hin tulo ka adlaw ginsumatan hi Laban nga pinmalagiw hi Jacob.
en: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

war: Makadamo ako pag-antos han kapaso han adlaw, ngan han kahagkot han gab-i. Waray ko maupay nga pagkaturog.
en: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.

war: andam ako hin pakigsabot ha imo. Pagtambak kita hin mga bato hin pagpahinumdom ha aton hini nga aton ginsabotan.”
en: Come now, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us.”

war: Sanglit kinmuha hi Jacob hin usa nga bato ngan igintindog ini sugad nga usa nga hinumdoman.
en: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.

war: Ginngaranan ini ni Laban nga Jagar-sahaduta, samtang ginngaranan ini ni Jacob nga Galeed.
en: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

war: Iini an mga bato nga akon gintambak ha butnga naton, ngan iini an bato nga hinumdoman.
en: Laban also said to Jacob, “Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.

war: Han nagpapadayon hin paglakat hi Jacob, tinmapo ha iya in mga anghel.
en: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

war: Nagpauna hi Jacob hin mga surugoon ngadto kan Esau nga iya bugto didto ha tuna han Edumea.
en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

war: Naghunahuna hiya, “Kon umabot hi Esau ngan sulongon an syahan nga hugpo, bangin makapalagiw pa an ikaduha.”
en: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape.”

war: Iya ginpauna ha iya an mga regalo, ngan nagpalabay hiya hito nga gab-i didto han kampo.
en: So Jacob’s gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.

war: Katapos niya pagpataboka ha ira, iya liwat gindara ngadto ha tabok an ngatanan nga iya mga hiagi,
en: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.

war: “Ano an imo ngaran?” pinmakiana an tawo. “Jacob,” binmaton hiya.
en: The man asked him, “What is your name?” “Jacob,” he answered.

war: Nasirang na an adlaw han pagtalikod ni Jacob han Peniel, ngan nag-iingka hiya tungod han kaigo han iya pig-i.
en: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.

war: Nag-una ha ira hi Jacob ngan hinmapa hiya ha tuna hin makapito han tikaharani na hiya han iya bugto.
en: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

war: Kundi dinmalagan hi Esau hin pagtapo ha iya, ginggakos, ngan ginhadkan hiya. Nagtangis hira nga duha.
en: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

war: Niyan dinmaop an mga aruasawa upod an ira mga anak ngan yinmukbo hira.
en: Then the female servants and their children approached and bowed down.

war: Niyan dinmaop hi Lea ngan an iya mga anak, ngan ha kataposan dinmaop hira Jose ug Raquel ngan yinmukbo liwat hira.
en: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.

war: Kundi nagsiring hi Esau, “Bugto ko, igo na kadamo an akon hiagi; tipigi na la an imo.”
en: But Esau said, “I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself.”

war: Nagsiring hi Esau, “Pag-andam kita ngan pagkalakat. Mag-uuna ako ha imo.”
en: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way; I’ll accompany you.”

war: Sanglit hito nga adlaw ginmikan hi Esau hin pagbalik ngadto ha Edom.
en: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.

war: Nagtindog hiya hin usa nga altar didto ngan ginngaranan ini nga El, an Dyos han Israel.
en: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.

war: Usa ka adlaw kinmadto hi Dina nga anak nga babaye nira Jacob ug Lea hin pagbisita hin mga kababayen-an nga taga-Canaan.
en: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.

war: Kundi hinusayan hi Siquem kan Dina sanglit hinmigugma hiya ha iya ngan gintalinguha niya nga paghigugmaon hiya ni Dina.
en: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob; he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.

war: Ginmawas hi Hamor nga amay ni Siquem, hin pakighimangraw kan Jacob,
en: Then Shechem’s father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.

war: Makakatangdo la kami kon magsugad kamo ha amon, pinaagi hin pagtori han ngatanan niyo nga kalalaken-an.
en: We will enter into an agreement with you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.

war: Kundi kon diri niyo pagtumanon ini nga pagtori; dadad-on namon hi Dina ngan malakat kami.”
en: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we’ll take our sister and go.”

war: Nakalipay ini nga ira mga pulong kan Hamor ngan kan Siquem nga iya anak,
en: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.

war: Kundi binmaton hira, “Diri kami makakatugot nga pagsusugaron la hin usa nga maraot nga babaye an amon bugto.”
en: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”

war: Inmabot hi Jacob upod an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo ngadto ha Luz nga kinikilala na yana nga Betel, didto ha tuna han Canaan.
en: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.

war: Han pagbalik ni Jacob tikang ha Mesopotamia, pinmakita na liwat ha iya an Dyos, ngan ginbendisyonan hiya.
en: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

war: Niyan binayaan hiya han Dyos.
en: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.

war: Ginngaranan niya nga Betel ini nga dapit.
en: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.

war: Han kamatay ni Raquel, iginlubong hiya ha ligid han dalan tipakadto ha Efrata nga kinikilala na yana nga Betlehem.
en: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

war: Nagpadayon hi Jacob ngan nagkampo hiya didto han luyo nga dapit han lantawan han Eder.
en: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.

war: An mga anak ni Lea amo hira Ruben (an suhag nga lalake ni Jacob), Simeon, Levi, Juda, Isacar, ug Zabulon.
en: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.

war: An mga anak ni Raquel amo hira Jose ug Benjamin.
en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

war: An mga anak ni Bilha nga oripon ni Raquel amo hira Dan ug Neftali.
en: The sons of Rachel’s servant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.

war: Nakaabot hi Isaac hin panuigon nga 180,
en: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Esau nga gintawag liwat nga Edom.
en: This is the account of the family line of Esau (that is, Edom).

war: ug Basemat nga anak nga babaye ni Ismael, ngan bugto ni Nebaiot.
en: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

war: Nag-anak hi Ada kan Elifas; nag-anak hi Basemat kan Reuel;
en: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,

war: Sanglit nag-ukoy hi Esau didto han sagkahon nga tuna han Edom.
en: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.

war: Amo ini an mga tulin ni Esau nga ginikanan han mga Edomitanhon.
en: This is the account of the family line of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.

war: Core, Gatam, ug Amalec. Mga tulin ini ngatanan ni Ada nga asawa ni Esau.
en: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.

war: Tinmikang kan Esau ini ngatanan nga mga tribo.
en: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.

war: Amo hi Sobal an ginikanan han mga banay nira Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Sefo, ug Onam.
en: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

war: Hi Eser amo an ginikanan han mga banay nira Bilhan, Saavan ug Jacan.
en: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.

war: Hi Disan amo an ginikanan han mga banay nira Hus ug Aran.
en: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

war: 29-30 Amo ini an Horitanhon nga mga tribo didto ha tuna han Edom: nira Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dison, Eser, ug Disan.
en: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.

war: Nagpadayon hi Jacob hin pag-ukoy didto ha tuna han Canaan nga gin-ukyan han iya amay,
en: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Pamatii daw niyo an akon inop.
en: He said to them, “Listen to this dream I had:

war: Naawa ha iya an kabugtoan ni Jose, kundi ginpainoino han iya amay ini ngatanan nga mga butang.
en: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.

war: Usa ka adlaw han paghingadto ha Siquem han kabugtoan ni Jose hin pagmangno han panon han ira amay,
en: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father’s flocks near Shechem,

war: ngan nagsinudoysudoy hiya didto han kaumhan. Hinkit-an hiya hin usa ka tawo ngan ginpakianhan hiya, “Ano an imo ginbibiling?”
en: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, “What are you looking for?”

war: Binmaton hiya, “Nagbibiling ako han akon kabugtoan nga nagmamangno han ira panon. Makakagsumat ka ba ha akon kon hain hira?”
en: He replied, “I’m looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?”

war: Naggipasiringsiring hira, “Iini na an parainop.
en: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to each other.

war: Hinbatian hira ni Ruben ngan nagtalinguha hi Ruben hin pagtalwas kan Jose. “Ayaw ta hiya pagpataya,” nagsiring hiya.
en: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. “Let’s not take his life,” he said.

war: Niyan gintalo hiya nira ngan iginlabog hiya ngadto han atabay nga mamara.
en: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. The cistern was empty; there was no water in it.

war: Binmalik hiya ngadto han iya kabugtoan ngan nagsiring, “Waray na didto an bata! Ano daw la an akon pagbubuhaton?”
en: He went back to his brothers and said, “The boy isn’t there! Where can I turn now?”

war: Didto iginkita hi Juda hin usa nga babaye nga Canaanhon kanay amay ginngaranan nga Sua. Pinangasawa niya an babaye
en: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and made love to her;

war: ngan nag-anak hira hin usa nga lalake nga ginngaranan niya nga Er.
en: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.

war: Nagburod liwat an babaye ngan nag-anak hin usa pa nga lalake ngan ginngaranan niya nga Onan.
en: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.

war: Para kan Er nga iya suhag nga lalake kinmuha hi Juda hin usa nga asawa kanay ngaran amo hi Tamar.
en: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

war: Maraot an ginawian ni Er ngan nakapabido ini han Ginoo , sanglit ginpatay hiya han Ginoo .
en: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.

war: Nakapabido han Ginoo an iya ginbuhat, ngan ginpatay liwat hiya han Ginoo .
en: What he did was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death also.

war: May nagsumat kan Tamar nga tikadto ha Timna an iya ugangan nga lalake hin pag-arot han iya mga karnero.
en: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,”

war: Inmoli hi Tamar, ginhukas an iya panyo, ngan iginbalik niya hin pagsul-ot an iya mga panapton hin balo.
en: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow’s clothes again.

war: Han pag-abot na han panahon ha iya pag-anak, hinbaroan nga karuha an iya ig-aanak.
en: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

war: Nakada kan Jose an Ginoo ngan ginhimo hiya nga mainuswagon. Nag-ukoy hiya didto han balay han iya agaron nga Ehiptohanon,
en: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.

war: nga nakakita nga nakada kan Jose an Ginoo nga naghimo ha iya nga mainuswagon ha ngatanan nga iya ginbuhat.
en: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,

war: Waray pag-iha nagtikang hin kaipa kan Jose an asawa han iya agaron ngan ginhangyo hi Jose nga makighilawas ha iya.
en: and after a while his master’s wife took notice of Joseph and said, “Come to bed with me!”

war: Bisan kon ginhangyo niya hi Jose adlaw-adlaw, waray gud umalagad hi Jose hin pakighilawas ha iya.
en: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.

war: Han paghikit-i han babaye nga binayaan ni Jose an iya hilawig nga bado ngan dinmalagan ha gawas han balay,
en: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,

war: Ginhimos niya an hilawig nga bado ni Jose tubtob han pag-uli han agaron ni Jose.
en: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.

war: Nasina hiya hini nga duha nga mga opisyal,
en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,

war: ngan ginpriso hira didto han balay han kapitan han gwardya, didto han amo manta nga dapit nga ginbutangan kan Jose.
en: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.

war: Han pagkadtoa ha ira ni Jose dida han aga, hinkit-an niya nga masulob-on hira.
en: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.

war: Nagsiring hi Jose, “Amo ini an kahulogan hini: an tulo nga mga sanga amo an tulo ka adlaw.
en: “This is what it means,” Joseph said to him. “The three branches are three days.

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Amo ini an kahulogan: an tulo nga mga basket amo an tulo ka adlaw.
en: “This is what it means,” Joseph said. “The three baskets are three days.

war: kundi iya iginpapatay an labaw nga parahimo hin tinapay. Natuman an ngatanan sugad gud han iginsiring ni Jose.
en: but he impaled the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation.

war: Kundi waray nagud hinumdomi hi Jose han tinaporan han bino—iya hinkalimtan na gud la hiya.
en: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.

war: Paglabay hin duha ka tuig nag-inop an hadi han Ehipto nga natukdaw hiya ha ligid han Salog han Nilo.
en: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,

war: ngan pinangaon han pito nga maggasaay nga mga baka an pito nga magtambok nga mga baka. Onina nagmata an hadi.
en: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.

war: Niyan binmuswak liwat in pito nga lain nga mga uhay hin trigo nga mga kuyapi ngan mga apa tungod han mapaso nga hangin,
en: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—thin and scorched by the east wind.

war: Usa ka gab-i nag-inop an kada usa ha amon ngan may-ada magkalain nga mga kahulogan an mga inop.
en: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Diri ako makakahimo, Harangdon nga Hadi, kundi mahatag an Dyos hin maupay nga paghubad.”
en: “I cannot do it,” Joseph replied to Pharaoh, “but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires.”

war: Kinaon han maggasaay nga mga baka an magtambok nga mga baka,
en: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.

war: Niyan binmuswak in pito nga mga uhay hin trigo nga mga kuyapi ngan apa tungod han mapaso nga hangin.
en: After them, seven other heads sprouted—withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.

war: Amo gud ini sumala han akon iginsumat ha imo—iginpakita ha imo han Dyos kon ano an iya pagbubuhaton.
en: “It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

war: Magkakamay-ada pito ka tuig nga kahuraan ha bug-os nga tuna han Ehipto.
en: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,

war: Hingangalimtan gud an panahon hin kahuraan kay makalilisang an masunod nga gutom.
en: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.

war: “Yana kinahanglan magpili ka hin tawo nga makinaadmananon ngan maaram ngan igbutang mo hiya nga tinaporan han nasod.
en: “And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.

war: Gin-abuyonan han hadi ngan han iya mga opisyal ini nga larang,
en: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.

war: Yana gintutudlok ko ikaw nga gobernador han bug-os nga Ehipto.”
en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt.”

war: Sulod han pito ka tuig nga kahuraan naghatag an tuna hin damo gud nga mga abot.
en: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.

war: Natapos an pito ka tuig nga kahuraan nga ginpahimulosan han tuna han Ehipto,
en: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,

war: Sanglit kinmadto an kan Jose napulo nga kabugtoan ha amay hin pagpalit hin trigo didto ha Ehipto,
en: Then ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

war: Kinmilala hi Jose han iya kabugtoan, kundi waray hira kumilala ha iya.
en: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.

war: Binmaton hira, “Diri gad, ginoo. Kinmanhi kami sugad nga imo mga oripon, hin pagpalit hin pagkaon.
en: “No, my lord,” they answered. “Your servants have come to buy food.

war: Magburugto kami ngatanan. Diri gad kami mga espiya, ginoo, tangkod kami nga mga tawo.”
en: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies.”

war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jose, “Diri! Kinmanhi kamo hin pag-inaw kon hain an maluya nga dapit han amon nasod.”
en: “No!” he said to them. “You have come to see where our land is unprotected.”

war: Binmaton hi Jose, “Sumala han akon iginsiring, mga espiya gud kamo.
en: Joseph said to them, “It is just as I told you: You are spies!

war: Katapos hito, iya ginpriso hira sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.
en: And he put them all in custody for three days.

war: Nasayoran ni Jose an ira iginsiring, kundi waray hira makasabot, kay nakigkarukayakan hira ha iya pinaagi hin parahubad.
en: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.

war: Ginkargahan han kabugtoan an ira mga asno han trigo nga ira ginpalit, ngan nagkalakat hira.
en: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.

war: “Gin-isgan kami han gobernador han Ehipto ngan ginpasangilan kami nga mga espiya kontra han iya nasod.
en: “The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.

war: Binmaton kami, ‘Diri gad kami mga espiya, mga tangkod la kami nga mga tawo.
en: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.

war: Nagtikagrabi an gutom didto ha Canaan,
en: Now the famine was still severe in the land.

war: Kon tumugot ka nga umupod ha amon an amon bugto, makadto kami ngan mapalit hin pagkaon para ha imo.
en: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

war: Kon waray pa kami paghinulat hin maiha, ngada yana makaduha na unta kami pakabalik.”
en: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice.”

war: Dad-a an iyo bugto, ngan balik kamo dayon.
en: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.

war: Ginbuhat han surugoon sumala han iginsugo ha iya, ngan gindara an magburugto ngadto han balay ni Jose.
en: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph’s house.

war: Sanglit dida han porta han balay, nagsiring hira ngadto han surugoon nga tinaporan,
en: So they went up to Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

war: “Kon mahimo, mano, kinmanhi kami hadto makausa hin pagpalit hin pagkaon.
en: “We beg your pardon, our lord,” they said, “we came down here the first time to buy food.

war: Timprano pa han pagkaaga, ginpalakat an magburugto dara an ira mga asno.
en: As morning dawned, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.

war: Han paghiabti ha ira han surugoon, iginyakan niya ha ira ini ngahaw nga mga pulong.
en: When he caught up with them, he repeated these words to them.

war: Kon hiagian in usa ha amon nga may-ada hini nga kupa, kinahanglan pagpatayon hiya, ngan magigin mga oripon nimo kami ngatanan.”
en: If any of your servants is found to have it, he will die; and the rest of us will become my lord’s slaves.”

war: Sanglit ginhaw-as dayon nira ha tuna an ira mga sako, ngan ginbukas an sako han kada tawo.
en: Each of them quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.

war: Ginpakianhan mo kami, ‘May-ada ba niyo amay, o lain nga bugto nga lalake?’
en: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’

war: Ginsiring mo kami hin pagdara ha iya nganhi basi makakita ka ha iya,
en: “Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.’

war: “Han pagbalik namon ngadto han amon amay, amon hiya ginsumatan han imo iginsiring.
en: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.

war: Niyan ginpabalik kami niya ngan ginpapalit hin pagkaon.
en: “Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy a little more food.’

war: Ikaduha pala ka tuig ini nga gutom dinhe ha tuna; may-ada lilima pa ka tuig nga mawawaray pag-arado o pag-ani.
en: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will be no plowing and reaping.

war: Ginpagikan niya an iya kabugtoan ngan han nalakat na hira, gintugon niya hira, “Ayaw kamo pag-aruaraway dida han dalan.”
en: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, “Don’t quarrel on the way!”

war: Ginmawas hira han Ehipto ngan nangoli hira ngadto kan Jacob nga ira amay didto ha Canaan.
en: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

war: ngan an mga anak nga kalalaken-an ni Ruben: hira Hanoc, Falu, Hesron, ug Carmi.
en: The sons of Reuben: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.

war: Hi Levi ngan an iya mga anak: hira Gerson, Coat, ug Merari.
en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

war: Hi Isacar ngan an iya mga anak: hira Tola, Pua, Jasub, ug Simron.
en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.

war: Hi Zabulon ngan an iya mga anak: hira Sered, Elon, ug Jaleel.
en: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.

war: Hi Gad ngan an iya mga anak: hira Sifeon, Hagi, Suni, Ezbon, Eri, Arod, ug Areli.
en: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.

war: Nag-anak hira Raquel ug Jacob hin duha nga lalake: hira Jose ug Benjamin.
en: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

war: Hira Bela, Bequer, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim, ug Ard nga mga anak ni Benjamin.
en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.

war: Amo ini nga 14 an mga tulin nira Jacob ug Raquel.
en: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob—fourteen in all.

war: Hi Dan ngan hi Husim nga iya anak.
en: The son of Dan: Hushim.

war: Hi Neftali ngan an iya mga anak: hira Jazeel, Guni, Jezer, ug Silem.
en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.

war: Kon tawgon kamo han hadi ngan magpakiana kon ano an iyo pagpakabuhi,
en: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’

war: Niyan iginpakilala niya han hadi an iya kabugtoan.
en: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.

war: Nagsiring an hadi kan Jose, “Yana nga nagkaabot na an imo amay ngan an imo kabugtoan,
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Your father and your brothers have come to you,

war: Niyan gindara ni Jose hi Jacob nga iya amay ngan iginpakilala hiya han hadi. Ginbendisyonan ni Jacob an hadi,
en: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,

war: ngan ginpakianhan hiya han hadi, “Pira na an imo panuigon?”
en: Pharaoh asked him, “How old are you?”

war: Ginbendisyonan ni Jacob hin panamilit an hadi, ngan linmakat hiya.
en: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.

war: Ginhimo ni Jose nga mga oripon an mga tawo tikang ha usa ngadto ha luyo nga kataposan han Ehipto.
en: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.

war: Binmaton hira, “Gintalwas mo an amon mga kinabuhi; kinalooyan mo kami, ngan mga oripon kami han hadi.”
en: “You have saved our lives,” they said. “May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh.”

war: Han paghikit-i la ni Jacob han mga anak ni Jose, nagpakiana hiya, “Hira hin-o ini?”
en: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”

war: Niyan ginkuha ni Jose tikang han mga paa ni Jacob an mga bata, ngan hinmapa hi Jose ha atubangan ni Jacob.
en: Then Joseph removed them from Israel’s knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.

war: “Pag-alirong ngan pamati kamo mga anak ni Jacob. Pamati kan Israel nga iyo amay.
en: “Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.

war: “Magbugto hira Simeon ug Levi. Ginagamit nira hin paglupig an ira mga hinganiban.
en: “Simeon and Levi are brothers— their swords are weapons of violence.

war: Magpula an iya mga mata tungod hin pag-ininom hin bino, Magbusag an iya mga ngipon tungod hin pag-ininom hin gatas.
en: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.

war: “Pareho la hin asno hi Isacar Nga naunat hin pagluob ha butnga han mga magbug-at nga mga dara han asno.
en: “Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down among the sheep pens.

war: “Mahihinto nga pangulo han iya katawhan hi Dan. Masusugad hira han iba nga mga tribo han Israel.
en: “Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

war: “Naghuhulat ako han imo pagtalwas, O Ginoo .
en: “I look for your deliverance, Lord .

war: “Pagsusulongon hi Gad hin hugpo hin mga tikasan, Kundi aasdangon ngan lalanaton niya hira.
en: “Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.

war: “Mabunga hin magrasa nga pagkaon an tuna ni Aser. Mahatag hiya hin pagkaon nga angay para hin usa nga hadi.
en: “Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.

war: “Usa nga layaw nga bugsok hi Neftali, Nga nag-aanak hin magtahom nga mga nati.
en: “Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

war: Sinusulong hiya hin waray kalooy han iya mga kaaway, Ngan ginlalanat hiya han ira mga pana.
en: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.

war: “Sugad hin mapintas nga lubo hi Benjamin. Pinapatay an iya tinutukob ngan kinakaon adlaw gab-i.”
en: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”

war: Ginpalit tikang han mga Hiteohanon an uma ngan an lungib nga aada hini. Iglubong ako niyo didto.”
en: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. ”

war: Hinangkopan dayon ni Jose an iya amay ngan nagtinangis nga naghihinarok han iya bayhon.
en: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.

war: Binmaton an hadi, “Kadto na ngan iglubong an imo amay sumala han imo iginsumpa.”
en: Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”

war: Binmunyog liwat ha iya in mga tawo nga mga dikaruwahe, ngan mga dikabayo; dako hin duro adto nga hugpo.
en: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.

war: Sanglit ginbuhat han mga anak ni Jacob sumala han iginsugo niya ha ira;
en: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:

war: Sanglit nagpadara hira kan Jose hini nga mensahe: “Han waray pa kamamatay an aton amay,
en: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Your father left these instructions before he died:

war: Kundi nagsiring ha ira hi Jose, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Diri ako makakahimo hin pagsaliwan han Dyos.
en: But Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

war: Nagpadayon hi Jose hin pag-ukoy didto ha Ehipto upod han panimalay han iya amay; 110 na an iya panuigon han kamatay niya.
en: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years

war: Maaanaw hira ngatanan, kundi magpapabilin ka; madadaan hira ngatanan sugad hin mga panapton.
en: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

war: Waray igbutang han Dyos an mga anghel nga maghahadi han tiarabot nga bag-o nga kalibutan—an kalibutan nga amon hinnanabihan.
en: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

war: ngan matalwas niya adton mga naoripon ha bug-os nira nga kinabuhi tungod han ira kahadlok han kamatayon.
en: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

war: Ngan yana makakabulig na hiya hadton mga ginsusulay, kay ginsulay ngan nag-antos man hiya ngahaw.
en: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

war: Matuod, hinimo hin tawo an kada balay—kundi an Dyos an naghimo han ngatanan nga mga butang.
en: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

war: Sanglit sumala han siring han Espiritu Santo: “Kon hibatian niyo an tingog han Dyos yana nga adlaw,
en: So, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear his voice,

war: Ira ako ginsulay ngan ginsarihan didto, nasiring an Dyos, bisan kon hinkit-an nira an akon ginbuhat sulod hin kwarenta ka tuig.
en: where your ancestors tested and tried me, though for forty years they saw what I did.

war: Napungot ngan nanumpa ako: ‘Diri gud hira makakasulod ngan makakapahuway upod ha akon!’”
en: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ ”

war: Sanglit aton nakikita nga waray hira makasulod, kay waray man hira tumoo.
en: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.

war: Amo man gihapon ini an ginsiring: “Diri gud hira makasulod ngan makakapahuway upod ha akon.”
en: And again in the passage above he says, “They shall never enter my rest.”

war: Kundi may-ada adlaw nga pagpahuway para han mga tawo han Dyos sugad han pagpahuway han Dyos ha ikapito ka adlaw.
en: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;

war: Nagsiring liwat hiya ha lain nga bahin hin kasuratan, “Magigin padi ka ha kadayonan, sugad han pagkapadi ni Melquisedec.”
en: And he says in another place, “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”

war: Kundi bisan kon Anak hiya han Dyos nahibaro hiya hin kamasinugtanon pinaagi han iya mga pag-antos.
en: Son though he was, he learned obedience from what he suffered

war: Han kahingpit na niya, nahimo hiya nga burabod han dayon nga katalwasan para hadton ngatanan nga masinugtanon ha iya.
en: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him

war: Ngan iginpakilala hiya han Dyos nga Labaw hiya nga Padi, dida han hugpo hin pagkapadi ni Melquisedec.
en: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

war: Damo pa unta an amon isisiring hiunong hini nga butang, kundi makuri an pagsaysay hini ha iyo, kay mahinay gud kamo makasabot.
en: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to make it clear to you because you no longer try to understand.

war: Yana pagpadayon na kita! Ngan amo ini an aton bubuhaton, kon itugot ini han Dyos.
en: And God permitting, we will do so.

war: Hin-araan na nira an kamaupay han pulong han Dyos, ngan nakatagamtam na hira han mga gahom han tiarabot nga panahon.
en: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Nagsasaad ako ha imo nga pagpapakaupayon ko ikaw ngan ihahatag ko ha imo in damo nga katulinan.”
en: saying, “I will surely bless you and give you many descendants.”

war: Gin-ilob ini ni Abraham, sanglit kinarawat niya an iginsaad han Dyos.
en: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.

war: Waray ruhaduha nga darudako an nagbebendisyon kay han ginbebendisyonan.
en: And without doubt the lesser is blessed by the greater.

war: Kay kon liwanan an pagkapadi, kinahanglan liwanan liwat an balaod.
en: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed also.

war: Naklaro ini nga butang; dida han pagpakita hin lain nga padi nga sugad kan Melquisedec.
en: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

war: Kay nasiring an kasuratan, “Magpapadi ka ha kadayonan, dida han hugpo hin pagkapadi ni Melquisedec.”
en: For it is declared: “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”

war: Sanglit binayaan an daan nga lagda, kay maluya ini ngan waray gamit.
en: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless

war: Labot pa, aada liwat an sumpa han Dyos. Waray sugad hini nga sumpa han kahimo nga padi han iba.
en: And it was not without an oath! Others became priests without any oath,

war: Sanglit ini nga kalainan naghimo kan Jesus nga karig-onan hin mauruupay nga ginsaaran.
en: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantor of a better covenant.

war: Kundi buhi hin kadayonan hi Jesus, ngan an iya buruhaton hini pagkapadi waray itubyan ha iba.
en: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

war: Kon waray pa sayop an syahan nga ginsaaran, waray na unta kinahanglan hin ikaduha.
en: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.

war: Pasasayloon ko an ira mga sala, ngan diri ko na hinunumdoman an ira mga kasaypanan.”
en: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more.”

war: An syahan nga ginsaaran may-ada mga turumanon ngan may-ada dapit hin pagsingba nga hinimo la hin tawo.
en: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.

war: Ha luyo han ikaduha nga biray may-ada tulda nga ginngaranan nga Labi ka Baraan nga Dapit.
en: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,

war: Kon may-ada testamento, kinahanglan nga hibaroan nga patay na an naghimo,
en: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,

war: kay waray gamit an testamento samtang buhi pa an naghimo; may gamit la kon patay na an naghimo.
en: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.

war: Amo man ngani nga bisan an syahan nga ginsaaran ginparig-on pinaagi hin paggamit hin dugo.
en: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.

war: Ngan nagsiring hiya, “Amo ini an dugo nga nagpaparig-on han ginsaaran nga ginsugo han Dyos nga pagtumanon niyo.”
en: He said, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”

war: Kinahanglan mamatay an tagsa-tagsa makausa, ngan katapos hini paghukman hiya han Dyos.
en: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

war: Kundi, sugad hito yana an mga paghalad nagpapahinumdom matagtuig han mga tawo han ira mga sala.
en: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins.

war: Kay diri gud makakakuha han mga sala an dugo han mga baka ngan mga kanding.
en: It is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

war: Diri ka nalilipay hin mga mananap nga ginsusunog ha bawbaw han halaran, o hin mga halad pagkuha hin mga sala.
en: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.

war: Didto naghuhulat hiya yana tubtob nga himoon han Dyos an iya mga kaaway nga taramakan han iya mga tiil.
en: and since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool.

war: Sanglit pinaagi hin usa la nga paghalad hin unong ginhingpit niya ha kadayonan adton mga nalinisan han sala.
en: For by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.

war: Ngan nagpapamatuod liwat ha aton an Espiritu Santo. Una han ngatanan nagsiring hiya,
en: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:

war: Ngan, nasiring hiya, “Diri na gud ako manunomdom han ira mga sala ngan magraot nga mga binuhatan.”
en: Then he adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”

war: Sanglit kon ginpasaylo na ini nga mga sala, diri na kinahanglan in halad pagkuha hin mga sala.
en: And where these have been forgiven, sacrifice for sin is no longer necessary.

war: May-ada kita gamhanan nga padi nga tinaporan han balay han Dyos.
en: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

war: Kapti naton hini maupay an aton paglaom, kay makakasarig kita han Dyos nga magtutuman han iya saad.
en: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

war: Pagdinasigay kita ha usa kag usa hin pagpakita han gugma ngan pagbuhat hin maupay.
en: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds,

war: Ginpapatay hin waray kalooy an nagtatalapas han Balaod ni Moises, kon paghukman hin duha o tulo nga mga testigo nga salaan.
en: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

war: Makalilisang an pagkahulog ngadto han mga kamot han buhi nga Dyos!
en: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

war: Sanglit ayaw gud kamo pagturaw kay nagdadara ini hin dako nga kabaralsan.
en: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.

war: Kinahanglan magmailobon kamo basi makagtuman kamo han kaburut-on han Dyos, ngan karawaton niyo an iya mga iginsasaad.
en: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.

war: Kay sumala han siring han kasuratan, “Gutiay na la an panahon, ngan maabot na hiya nga ginpipinamulat, diri hiya maglalangan.
en: For, “In just a little while, he who is coming will come and will not delay.”

war: Pinaagi han ira pagtoo an mga tawo hadton una nga panahon ginpakaupay han Dyos.
en: This is what the ancients were commended for.

war: Kay ginhulat ni Abraham an syudad nga an Dyos amo an nagplano, naglarang ngan nagtukod, kanay patukoranan diri gud mapupukan.
en: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

war: Adton naghimangraw hin sugad, nagpapasabot nga nagbibiling hira hin tuna nga ira kalugaringon.
en: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.

war: Waray na hira mangandoy han tuna nga ira tinalikdan; kon naghunahuna pa hira, may-ada pa unta nira higayon hin pagbalik.
en: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

war: Nagsiring an Dyos kan Abraham, “Magkakamay-ada ka mga tulin pinaagi kan Isaac.”
en: even though God had said to him, “It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.”

war: Tungod hin pagtoo, nagsaad hi Isaac kanda Jacob ug Esau hin mga kaupayan para han tiarabot nga panahon.
en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.

war: Tungod hin pagtoo hi Moises, han batan-on na hiya, nagdumiri nga tawgon hiya nga anak han anak nga babaye ni Paraon.
en: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

war: Tungod hin pagtoo napukan an mga pader han Jerico, katapos paglibota han mga Israelita sulod hin pito ka adlaw.
en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the army had marched around them for seven days.

war: Ginpakaalohan ngan ginhampak an iba, ngan ginggapos ngan ginbilanggo an iba.
en: Some faced jeers and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.

war: kay may-ada pa an Dyos mauroupay nga paglarang para ha aton. Tuyo han Dyos nga mahihingpit la hira kon upod kita ha ira.
en: since God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.

war: Kay ha iyo pakig-away han sala, waray pa kamo mahitangpi han kamatayon.
en: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

war: Kay sinasaway han Ginoo an iya hinihigugma, ngan ginkakastigo niya an kinakarawat niya nga iya anak.”
en: because the Lord disciplines the one he loves, and he chastens everyone he accepts as his son.”

war: Sanglit alsaha niyo an iyo kinakapoy nga mga kamot, ngan pakusga an iyo magluya nga mga tuhod!
en: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.

war: Sulsoga niyo an matadong nga mga dalan, basi may gamit an piay nga tiil ngan maupay dayon.
en: “Make level paths for your feet,” so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

war: Talinguhaa hin pakigdaet ha ngatanan nga mga tawo, ngan pag-ukoy hin baraan nga kinabuhi, kay gawas hini waray makita han Ginoo.
en: Make every effort to live in peace with everyone and to be holy; without holiness no one will see the Lord.

war: Makalilisang hin duro adto nga taran-awon nga nakasiring hi Moises, “Nangungurog ngan nahahadlok ako!”
en: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”

war: kay kalayo gud nga nakakaugtang an aton Dyos.
en: for our “God is a consuming fire.”

war: Ipadayon an iyo minagburugto nga pagsihigugmaay dida ha pag-alagad kan Cristo.
en: Keep on loving one another as brothers and sisters.

war: Sanglit pagmaisog kita ngan magsiring, “An Ginoo an akon kabulig, diri ako mahahadlok. Ano ba in sadang buhaton ha akon?”
en: So we say with confidence, “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?”

war: Amo la gihapon hi Jesu-Cristo hadto, yana, ngan ha kadayonan.
en: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

war: An mga padi nga nag-aalagad didto han arampoan han mga Judiyo waray katungod hin pagkaon han mga hinalad ha aton altar.
en: We have an altar from which those who minister at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

war: Sanglit kadto kita ha iya ha gawas han kampo, ngan angbit kita han makaaalo nga ginbuhat ha iya.
en: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace he bore.

war: Kay waray dayon nga syudad para ha aton dinhe ha tuna; nangingita kita han syudad nga tiarabot.
en: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

war: Ayaw hingalimti an pagbuhat hin maupay nga an pagbinuligay, kay amo ini an mga halad nga nakakalipay han Dyos.
en: And do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

war: Ngan nanginginyupo pa gud ako ha iyo nga mag-ampo kamo nga pabalikon ako han Dyos ngada ha iyo ha madali nga panahon.
en: I particularly urge you to pray so that I may be restored to you soon.

war: Maada unta ha iyo ngatanan an grasya han Dyos.
en: Grace be with you all.

war: Kabugtoan ko, hunahunaa niyo nga palaran kamo kon naatubang kamo hin magkalainlain nga mga pagsulay,
en: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

war: kay kon nagdadaog an iyo pagtoo hin sugad nga mga pagsulay, pagpakita ito nga nahibaro kamo hin pag-ilob.
en: because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

war: Seguroha nga magpadayon an iyo kamailobon, basi mahingpit kamo, ngan mawaray kakulangan dida ha iyo.
en: Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

war: Kinahanglan magmalipayon an kablas nga bugto kon pahitas-on hiya han Dyos,
en: Believers in humble circumstances ought to take pride in their high position.

war: ngan an riko nga bugto kon paubson hiya han Dyos. Kay magpapapas an manggaranon sugad han bukad han tanom ha kapatagan.
en: But the rich should take pride in their humiliation—since they will pass away like a wild flower.

war: Kundi nasusulay an tawo kon nahuhugay ngan nabibitik hiya han iya kalugaringon nga maraot nga ungara.
en: but each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.

war: Hinigugma ko nga kabugtoan, ayaw kamo pagpalimbong!
en: Don’t be deceived, my dear brothers and sisters.

war: Diri nakakatuman han matadong nga tuyo han Dyos an kasina han tawo
en: because human anger does not produce the righteousness that God desires.

war: Natan-aw hiya hin maupay ha iya ngahaw, ngan katapos nalakat hiya, ngan hinngangalimtan dayon kon ano an iya hitsura.
en: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

war: dida hito nakakasala na kamo hin ka may-ada niyo pinili nga mga tawo ngan hin paghukom nga pinasikad hin magraot nga mga panuyo.
en: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?

war: Amo hira an nagmiminanggad hito nga maupay nga ngaran nga iginhatag han Dyos ha iyo.
en: Are they not the ones who are blaspheming the noble name of him to whom you belong?

war: An nagtatalapas hin usa nga sugo han Balaod, nagtatalapas han ngatanan.
en: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

war: Pagyakan ngan panggawi kamo sugad hin mga tawo nga paghuhukman han balaod nga nagtatalwas han mga tawo.
en: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom,

war: Kay diri malolooy an Dyos kon maghukom na hiya han tawo nga waray pagkalooy. Kundi dinadaog gud han kalooy an paghukom.
en: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

war: Pananglit may-ada kabugtoan nga nagkikinahanglan hin mga panapton ngan kulang hin pagkaon.
en: Suppose a brother or a sister is without clothes and daily food.

war: Amo man ini an pagtoo: kon pagtoo la, ngan waray padis nga buhat, patay ito nga pagtoo.
en: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

war: Natoo ka ba nga may uusa la nga Dyos? Maupay! Natoo man liwat hini an mga yawa ngan nangungurog hira hin kahadlok.
en: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.

war: Lurong ka! Karuyag ba nimo hikit-an nga waray kapulsanan an pagtoo nga diri inupdan hin mga buhat?
en: You foolish person, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless ?

war: Sanglit nakikita niyo nga gin-iisip nga matadong sa Dyos an tawo pinaagi han iya ginbubuhat ngan diri tungod la han iya pagtoo.
en: You see that a person is considered righteous by what they do and not by faith alone.

war: Sanglit, sugad nga patay an lawas kon waray espiritu; patay man an pagtoo kon waray mga buhat.
en: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

war: Kundi waray pa gud tawo nga nakagpaanad han dila. Maraot ngan makuri kapugngan, ngan puno hin makamaratay nga hilo.
en: but no human being can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

war: Naguwa ha usa la nga baba in mga pulong hin pagpasalamat ngan pagpakaraot. Kabugtoan ko, diri ini angay mahinabo!
en: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers and sisters, this should not be.

war: Diri mahihimo nga matikang hin usa ngan amo la ngahaw nga burabod in matam-is ug mapait nga tubig.
en: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

war: Diri natikang ha langit ini nga kinaadman; kinalibutanon la ini, yawan-on ngan diri espirituhanon.
en: Such “wisdom” does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

war: Kon hain an pangabugho ngan kahalot, aadto man an kasamok ngan ngatanan nga karat-an.
en: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.

war: Ngan an pagkamatadong amo an naaani nga bunga han mga binhe nga itinatanom han mga nagbubuhat dida hin kalinaw.
en: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap a harvest of righteousness.

war: Sanglit, pagsugot kamo han Dyos. Atohi niyo an Yawa ngan mapahirayo hiya ha iyo.
en: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

war: Pagmabidoon kamo, pagnguyngoy, ngan pagtangis; saliwani niyo hin pagtangis an iyo katatawa, ngan kabidoan an iyo kalipayan!
en: Grieve, mourn and wail. Change your laughter to mourning and your joy to gloom.

war: Pagpaubos kamo ha atubangan han Ginoo ngan pagpapahitas-on kamo niya.
en: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

war: Amo unta ini an angay niyo igsiring, “Kon tumugot an Ginoo, mabubuhi pa kami, ngan magbubuhat kami hini o hadto.”
en: Instead, you ought to say, “If it is the Lord’s will, we will live and do this or that.”

war: Kundi yana mapinahitas-on ngan nanhahambog kamo; sayop in sugad nga panhambog.
en: As it is, you boast in your arrogant schemes. All such boasting is evil.

war: Sanglit, nakakasala an tawo nga diri nagbubuhat han maupay nga iya hinbabaroan nga angay niya buhaton.
en: If anyone, then, knows the good they ought to do and doesn’t do it, it is sin for them.

war: Ngan yana, pamatii ako niyo, kamo nga mga riko! Pagtangis ngan pagnguyngoy kamo tungod han mga kagul-anan nga tiarabot ha iyo!
en: Now listen, you rich people, weep and wail because of the misery that is coming on you.

war: Nadunot na an iyo mga manggad ngan ginkutkot na an iyo mga panapton.
en: Your wealth has rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.

war: Ginsirotan nga ginpatay niyo an tawo nga waray sala, ngan waray hiya umato ha iyo.
en: You have condemned and murdered the innocent one, who was not opposing you.

war: Kinahanglan magmailobon liwat kamo. Magmalinaomon gud kamo kay hirani na an adlaw han pag-abot han Ginoo.
en: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.

war: May-ada ba nagkukuri ha iyo? Kinahanglan mag-ampo hiya. May-ada ba malipayon? Kinahanglan magkanta hiya hin mga pagdayaw.
en: Is anyone among you in trouble? Let them pray. Is anyone happy? Let them sing songs of praise.

war: Nag-ampo liwat hiya, ngan inmuran ngan nanmunga an mga tanom ha tuna.
en: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

war: Kabugtoan ko, kon mahimulag tikang han kamatuoran in usa ha iyo, ngan may-ada usa nga makapabalik ha iya,
en: My brothers and sisters, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring that person back,

war: Binmaton an Ginoo , “An tribo ni Juda an mauna, kay igintubyan ko na ha ira ini nga tuna.”
en: The Lord answered, “Judah shall go up; I have given the land into their hands.”

war: Tikang didto ginsulong han mga tawo han Juda an syudad han Dabir nga hadto nga panahon ginngaranan nga Quiriat-sefer.
en: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

war: Sumala han sugo ni Moises, iginhatag an Hebron kan Caleb nga nagpaiwas ha syudad han tulo nga mga banay nga mga tulin ni Anac.
en: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.

war: An pag-ultan han mga Edomitanhon natikang ha amihanan nga dapit han Sela tipakadto han Aragian han Akrabim.
en: The boundary of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and beyond.

war: sanglit ginngaranan nga Boquim ini nga dapit. Didto naghalad hira hin mga hayop nga ira tutuboron para han Ginoo .
en: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the Lord .

war: Namatay hi Josue nga anak ni Nun, nga surugoon han Ginoo ha panuigon nga 110.
en: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.

war: Niyan nakasala han Ginoo an mga tawo han Israel ngan nag-alagad na hira han mga Baal.
en: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord and served the Baals.

war: Hinmunong hira hin pagsingba han Ginoo ngan gin-alagad nira an mga Baal ngan an mga Astarte.
en: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

war: Niyan tinagan han Ginoo an mga Israelita hin mga maghurukom nga amo an magtatalwas ha ira tikang han mga parapanikas.
en: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.

war: diri ko na paiiwason an mga nasod nga nag-uokoy pa han ira tuna han kamatay ni Josue.
en: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.

war: Nagkamay-ada kalinaw didto han tuna sulod hin kwarenta ka tuig, ngan katapos namatay hi Otoniel.
en: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.

war: Ginsakop ni Eglon an mga Israelita sulod hin 18 ka tuig.
en: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.

war: Niyan iya gindara an mga regalo ngadto kan Eglon nga matambok hin duro nga tawo.
en: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

war: Han paghatagan na ha iya ni Ehud han mga regalo, ginpauli niya an mga tawo nga nagdara hini.
en: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way those who had carried it.

war: Pinaagi han iya wala nga kamot hinulbot ni Ehud an espada tikang han iya tuo nga kagiliran ngan iginbuno ini han tiyan han hadi.
en: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king’s belly.

war: Niyan ginmawas hi Ehud, ginsadhan an mga porta, gintrangkahan ini,
en: Then Ehud went out to the porch ; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.

war: Hito nga adlaw ginpirde han mga Israelita an Moab, ngan nagkamay-ada kalinaw didto han tuna sulod hin 80 ka tuig.
en: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.

war: Han kamatay ni Ehud, nakasala na liwat han Ginoo an mga tawo han Israel.
en: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the Lord , now that Ehud was dead.

war: Hadto nga panahon an maghurukom han Israel amo hi Debora, nga asawa ni Lapidot, ngan usa hiya nga manaragna.
en: Now Deborah, a prophet, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

war: Han paghibaro ni Sisera nga sinmagka hi Barac han Bukid Tabor,
en: When they told Sisera that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor,

war: Hito nga adlaw ginpadaog han Dyos an mga Israelita kontra kan Jabin nga Canaanhon nga Hadi.
en: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.

war: Hito nga adlaw ginkanta nira Debora ug Barac ini nga kanta:
en: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:

war: Nangurog an kabukiran ha atubangan han Ginoo han Sinai, ha atubangan han Ginoo nga Dyos han Israel.
en: The mountains quaked before the Lord , the One of Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel.

war: Niyan linmugsong an mga magtinumanon ngadto han ira mga pangulo; kinmadto ha iya an mga tawo han Ginoo nga andam hin pakig-away.
en: “The remnant of the nobles came down; the people of the Lord came down to me against the mighty.

war: Nakig-away an kabitun-an tikang ha langit; han paglatas hini han kalangitan, nakig-away ini kontra kan Sisera.
en: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

war: Niyan nagkaabot an mga kabayo nga nagdadadlagan, nga an ira mga tiil nagbabandok han tuna.
en: Then thundered the horses’ hooves— galloping, galloping go his mighty steeds.

war: Nangaro hin tubig hi Sisera, kundi tinagan hiya hin gatas; gindad-an hiya hin keso dida hin mahusay nga makaong.
en: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl fit for nobles she brought him curdled milk.

war: Ginbaton hiya han iya mag-aram nga kababayen-an, ngan hiya la an binmaton han iya kalugaringon.
en: The wisest of her ladies answer her; indeed, she keeps saying to herself,

war: ngan waray mahihimo han Israel hin pagkontra ha ira.
en: Midian so impoverished the Israelites that they cried out to the Lord for help.

war: Niyan nagtawag an mga tawo han Israel ngadto han Ginoo hin pakibulig kontra han mga Madianitanhon.
en: When the Israelites cried out to the Lord because of Midian,

war: Pinmakita ha iya didto an anghel han Ginoo ngan nagsiring, “Aada ha imo an Ginoo , ikaw nga maisog ngan kusgan nga tawo!”
en: When the angel of the Lord appeared to Gideon, he said, “The Lord is with you, mighty warrior.”

war: Kundi nagsiring ha iya an Ginoo , “An kamurayaw maada ha imo! Ayaw kahadlok. Diri ka mapatay.”
en: But the Lord said to him, “Peace! Do not be afraid. You are not going to die.”

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Gideon ngadto han Dyos, “Nagsiring ka nga gagamiton mo ako hin pagtalwas han Israel.
en: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand as you have promised—

war: Kundi kon nahahadlok ka hin pagsulong, lugsong ngadto han kampo upod hi Pura nga imo surugoon.
en: If you are afraid to attack, go down to the camp with your servant Purah

war: Sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Mabalik ako nga waray ako maano, ngan kon bumalik na ako, rurumpagon ko ini nga torre!”
en: So he said to the men of Peniel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower.”

war: Han nabalik na hi Gideon tikang han pag-awayan pinaagi han Agianan han Hares,
en: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.

war: Iya liwat ginrumpag an torre didto ha Penuel ngan pinamatay an kalalaken-an hito nga syudad.
en: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.

war: Binmalik hi Gideon ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga balay ngan didto hiya nag-ukoy.
en: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.

war: May-ada hiya 70 nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an, kay damo an iya asawa.
en: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.

war: Niyan ginsiring han kakahoyan an kahoy nga igos, ‘Kadi ngan paghadii kami.’
en: “Next, the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and be our king.’

war: Sanglit ginsiring han kakahoyan an ubas, ‘Kadi ngan paghadii kami.’
en: “Then the trees said to the vine, ‘Come and be our king.’

war: Sanglit ginsiring han ngatanan nga kakahoyan an tunukon nga kahoy, ‘Kadi ngan paghadii kami.’
en: “Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and be our king.’

war: Niyan tungod han iya kahadlok kan Abimelec nga iya bugto, kinmalagiw hi Jotam ngan didto nag-ukoy ha Beer.
en: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.

war: Naghadi han Israel hi Abimelec sulod hin tulo ka tuig.
en: After Abimelek had governed Israel three years,

war: Nasina hi Zebul nga pangulo han syudad han pagsumati ha iya han ginsiring ni Gaal.
en: When Zebul the governor of the city heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, he was very angry.

war: Sanglit yana, kinahanglan lumakat ka ha gab-i, ikaw ngan an imo mga tawo ngan tumago kamo ha kaumhan.
en: Now then, during the night you and your men should come and lie in wait in the fields.

war: Gin-unhan ni Gaal hin paggawas an mga tawo han Siquem ngan nakig-away hira kan Abimelec.
en: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.

war: Han pagkabuwas hinbaroan ni Abimelec nga naglarang an mga tawo han Siquem hin paggawas ngadto ha kaumhan,
en: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields, and this was reported to Abimelek.

war: Ginsumatan hi Abimelec nga nagtitirok hira didto,
en: When Abimelek heard that they had assembled there,

war: Niyan kinmadto ha Tebez hi Abimelec, ginpalibotan niya ang syudad, ngan iya nabihag.
en: Next Abimelek went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.

war: Han pag-abot ni Abimelec hin pagsulong han torre, kinmadto hiya ha porta hin pagsurit han torre.
en: Abimelek went to the tower and attacked it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,

war: Kundi ginhulogan hiya hin usa nga babaye hin gilingan nga bato ngan nabasag an iya ulo.
en: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.

war: Pangulo hiya han Israel sulod hin 23 ka tuig. Katapos namatay hiya ngan ginlubong didto ha Samir.
en: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.

war: Katapos ni Tola inmabot hi Jair nga taga-Galaad. Nangulo hiya han Israel sulod hin 22 ka tuig.
en: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.

war: Namatay hi Jair ngan iginlubong didto ha Camon.
en: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.

war: Kundi iyo ako gihapon ginbayaan ngan ginsingba niyo an iba nga kadiyosan, sanglit diri ko na kamo pagtatalwason liwat.
en: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.

war: Linmabay anay in panahon san-o makig-away an mga Amonitanhon kontra han Israel.
en: Some time later, when the Ammonites were fighting against Israel,

war: Ginsiring hiya nira, “Kadi ngan pagpangulohi kami basi makaaway kami kontra han mga Amonitanhon.”
en: “Come,” they said, “be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites.”

war: Ginpabalik ni Jefte in mga magsarangyaw ngadto han hadi han Amon
en: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,

war: Kundi waray gud bumali an hadi han Amon hini nga mensahe tikang kan Jefte.
en: The king of Ammon, however, paid no attention to the message Jephthah sent him.

war: Nagsaad han Ginoo hi Jefte: “Kon padag-on mo ako han mga Amonitanhon,
en: And Jephthah made a vow to the Lord : “If you give the Ammonites into my hands,

war: Sunod kan Jefte nangulo han Israel hi Ibzan nga taga-Betlehem.
en: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.

war: katapos namatay hiya ngan iginlubong didto ha Betlehem.
en: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

war: Katapos namatay hiya ngan iginlubong didto ha Ayalon, ha katunaan han Zabulon.
en: Then Elon died and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

war: Sunod kan Elon nangulo han Israel hi Abdon nga anak ni Ilel nga taga-Faraton.
en: After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel.

war: Ayaw gud pag-inom hin bino o irimnon nga makahurobog o pagkaon hin bisan ano nga igindidiri nga pagkaon;
en: Now see to it that you drink no wine or other fermented drink and that you do not eat anything unclean.

war: Binmaton an anghel han Ginoo , “Kinahanglan buhaton han imo asawa an ngatanan nga akon iginsiring ha iya.
en: The angel of the Lord answered, “Your wife must do all that I have told her.

war: Pinmakiana an anghel, “Kay ano nga karuyag niyo mahibaro han akon ngaran? Makatitingala ini nga ngaran.”
en: He replied, “Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding. ”

war: Ginsiring ni Manoa an iya asawa, “Mamamatay gud kita kay kinita kita han Dyos!”
en: “We are doomed to die!” he said to his wife. “We have seen God!”

war: Usa ka adlaw linmugsong hi Samson ngadto ha Timna diin hinkit-an niya in usa nga babaye nga Filisteohanon.
en: Samson went down to Timnah and saw there a young Philistine woman.

war: Niyan kinmadto hiya ngan nakighimangraw hiya han babaye ngan naruyagan niya an babaye.
en: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and he liked her.

war: Han pakakita ha iya han mga Filisteohanon, nagsugo hira hin 30 nga mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an hin pagpaupod ha iya.
en: When the people saw him, they chose thirty men to be his companions.

war: ngan iginhatag an iya asawa ngadto han tawo nga iya abay dida han pagkasal.
en: And Samson’s wife was given to one of his companions who had attended him at the feast.

war: Nagsiring hi Samson, “Hini nga higayon diri na ako manginginlabot han akon bubuhaton han mga Filisteohanon!”
en: Samson said to them, “This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them.”

war: Nagkaabot an mga Filisteohanon ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Juda. Ginsulong nira an bungto han Lehi.
en: The Philistines went up and camped in Judah, spreading out near Lehi.

war: Ginpangulohan ni Samson an Israel sulod hin 20 ka tuig samtang an mga Filisteohanon naghahadi han tuna.
en: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

war: Katapos hini hinmigugma hi Samson hin usa nga babaye nga ginngaranan kan Dalila nga nag-ukoy didto ha Kahamub-an han Sorec.
en: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.

war: Kundi nagtikang na liwat hin pagtubo an iya buhok.
en: But the hair on his head began to grow again after it had been shaved.

en: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim

en: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.

war: Hito ngahaw nga panahon may-ada usa nga batan-on nga Levita nga nag-ukoy anay didto han bungto han Betlehem ha Juda.
en: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,

war: Inmuyon an batan-on nga Levita hin pagpabilin upod kan Miqueas ngan nahimo hiya nga sugad hin usa han iya mga anak.
en: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man became like one of his sons to him.

en: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.

war: Binmaton hiya, “May-ada kami ginkasabotan ngan hi Miqueas nga nagsusuhol ha akon ha pag-alagad ko nga padi para ha iya.”
en: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, “He has hired me and I am his priest.”

war: Binmaton an padi, “Waray niyo sadang kabarak-an. Ginmamangnoan kamo han Ginoo dida hini nga iyo paglakaton.”
en: The priest answered them, “Go in peace. Your journey has the Lord ’s approval.”

war: Tikang didto nagpadayon hira ngan inmabot hira ha balay ni Miqueas didto han sagkahon nga nasod han Efraim.
en: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.

war: Sanglit sinmulod hira ngadto han balay hi Miqueas, nga inuokyan han batan-on nga Levita, ngan pinangumosta nira an Levita.
en: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah’s place and greeted him.

war: Binmalik hira ngan nagkalakat hira. Nag-una ha ira an ira kabataan, ira kabakahan, ngan an ira mga higamit.
en: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.

en: But now this is what we’ll do to Gibeah: We’ll go up against it in the order decided by casting lots.

war: Sanglit nagkatirok an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an didto ha Israel ngan usa la an ira tuyo—pagsulong han bungto.
en: So all the Israelites got together and united as one against the city.

war: Sanglit han pagkaaga nagkalakat an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira hirani han syudad han Gabaa.

en: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.

war: Sanglit ginpatago han mga Israelita an iba han mga sondalo palibot han Gabaa.
en: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.

war: Pinamatay in 18,000 han gimamag-upayi nga Benjaminhon nga mga sondalo.
en: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.

war: han pagpundoka han mga tawo waray didto taga-Habes.
en: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.
