en: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.

war: Mas kalolooyan pa han Dyos an Tiro ug Sidon, kay ha iyo, ha Adlaw han Paghukom.
en: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.

war: Ngan para ha imo Capernaum, karuyag mo ba mag-undong han imo kalugaringon ngadto ha langit? Ilalabog ka ngadto ha impyerno!”
en: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades.

war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Hinkit-an ko hi Satanas nga nahulog sugad hin kikidlat tikang ha langit.
en: He replied, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Ano an siring han Kasuratan? Inuunano mo hin pagsaysay ha ira?”
en: “What is written in the Law?” he replied. “How do you read it?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Igo an imo baton; buhata ini ngan mabubuhi ka.”
en: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus replied. “Do this and you will live.”

war: May-ada bugto hi Marta nga Maria an ngaran, nga linmingkod ha tiilan han Ginoo ngan namati han iya gintututdo.
en: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to what he said.

war: Binmaton ha iya an Ginoo, “Marta, Marta! Naguguol ngan nababaraka ka hin damo nga mga butang,
en: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord answered, “you are worried and upset about many things,

war: kundi usa la an kinahanglanon. Ginpili ni Maria an labi ka maupay nga butang, ngan diri na ini maaagaw ha iya.”
en: but few things are needed—or indeed only one. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her.”

war: Tagi kami adlaw-adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.
en: Give us each day our daily bread.

war: Inmabot ha akon balay in usa ko nga sangkay nga naglalakaton, ngan waray ko sadang igdurot ha iya!’
en: a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have no food to offer him.’

war: Kay makarawat an nangangaro, ngan makakaagi an namimiling, ngan aabrehan an porta ha iya nga nagtutuktok.
en: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

war: May-ada ba usa ha iyo nga mga amay, nga mahatag han iya anak hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?
en: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

war: O tatagan ba niyo hiya hin bungad kon mangaro hiya hin bonay?
en: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?

war: Diri, nagpapaguwa lugod ako hin yawa, pinaagi han gahom han Dyos, nga nagpapamatuod nga inmabot na ha iyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.
en: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

war: Sanglit nabalik an yawa ngan nakita han balay nga malinis ngan inayad na an ngatanan.
en: When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.

war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Lugod pagkapalaran hadton mga namamati ngan nagtutuman han pulong han Dyos!”
en: He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”

war: Sanglit paghirot nga an kapawa dida ha iyo diri mahimo nga kasisidman.
en: See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.

war: Nahipausa an Parisiyo han pakakita niya, nga waray anay manhunaw hi Jesus san-o kumaon.
en: But the Pharisee was surprised when he noticed that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.

war: Mga lurong! Diri ba an Dyos nga naghimo han gawas, amo liwat an naghimo han sakob?
en: You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?

war: Kundi ihatag ha mga kablas an sulod han iyo mga tasa ug plato ngan magmamalinis an ngatanan para ha iyo.
en: But now as for what is inside you—be generous to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.

war: Nagsiring ha iya in usa han mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Magturutdo, kon nasiring ka hini ginpapakaalohan nimo kami!”
en: One of the experts in the law answered him, “Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also.”

war: nga nagtalingoha hira hin pagbitik ngan pagdakop ha iya dida hin sayop nga iya igyayakan.
en: waiting to catch him in something he might say.

war: Mabubuksan an bisan ano nga tinahoban, ngan mahibabaroan an tagsa nga tinago.
en: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

war: Kay tututdoan kamo han Espiritu Santo, hito nga takna, kon ano an angay niyo igyakan.”
en: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Hin-o in naghatag ha akon hin katungod hin paghukom o pagbahin han malon niyo nga duha?”
en: Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?”

war: Niyan iginsumat ha ira ni Jesus ini nga pananglitan: “May usa ka tawo nga riko nga may-ada uma nga kinmuha hin damo nga abot.
en: And he told them this parable: “The ground of a certain rich man yielded an abundant harvest.

war: Naghunahuna hiya, ‘Waray ko na dapit nga hihimosan han ngatanan nga akon mga abot. Ano ba an akon bubuhaton?
en: He thought to himself, ‘What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.’

war: Labaw pa ka importante an kinabuhi kay han pagkaon, ngan labaw pa ka importante an lawas kay han panapton.
en: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.

war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakadugang hin pira ka tuig han iya kinabuhi pinaagi hin pagkinabaraka?
en: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to your life ?

war: Kon diri man kamo nakakahimo bisan han mga gudtiay nga butang, kay ano nga mababaraka kamo hiunong han iba nga mga butang?
en: Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?

war: Sanglit ayaw kamo pagpinangarit, nga dayuday la nababaraka hiunong han iyo kakaonon ngan iimnom.
en: And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.

war: Lugod unaha niyo hin pagbiling an Ginhadian, ngan tatagan kamo niya hini nga mga butang.
en: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.

war: “Ayaw kamo kahadlok, gutiay nga panon, kay nalilipay an Amay niyo hin paghatag ha iyo han Ginhadian.
en: “Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

war: Kon hain an imo mga manggad dayuday aadto man an imo kasingkasing.
en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

war: Ngan pag-andam man liwat kamo, kay maabot an Anak han Tawo ha takna nga diri niyo ginpapamulat hiya.”
en: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.”

war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Ginoo, iginsusumat mo ba ini nga pananglitan para la ha amon, o para ba ini han ngatanan?”
en: Peter asked, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?”

war: Palaran adto nga surugoon nga hiabtan han iya agaron ha iya pagbalik, nga nagbubuhat hini!
en: It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.

war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod, itatapod han agaron hadto nga surugoon an ngatanan nga iya mga manggad.
en: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

war: “Kinmanhi ako hin pagsunog han tuna; karuyag ko unta nga magdilaab na ini!
en: “I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

war: May-ada bunyag nga akon kakarawaton nga diri ako mahimumutang tubtob nga matapos ini!
en: But I have a baptism to undergo, and what constraint I am under until it is completed!

war: Tikang yana, mababahin in panimalay nga may lima nga mga sakop, an tulo kontra han duha, ug an duha kontra han tulo.
en: From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.

war: “Kay ano nga diri man kamo magtirutimbang kon ano an angay buhaton?
en: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

war: Susumatan ko kamo, diri ka makakagawas didto, tubtob nga kabaydan mo an multa han kataposan mo nga sintabo.”
en: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.”

war: Diri! Susumatan ko kamo nga kon diri kamo bumaya han iyo mga sala, mapatay kamo ngatanan sugad ha ira.
en: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

war: Diri! Susumatan ko kamo nga kon diri kamo bumaya han iyo mga sala, mapatay kamo ngatanan sugad ha ira.”
en: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”

war: Manggad nala bumunga han sunod nga tuig; kay kon diri pa, amo na in pagpudla naton.’”
en: If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.’ ”

war: Usa ka Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nagtutdo hi Jesus didto hin usa nga sinagoga.
en: On a Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,

war: Han paghikit-i ha iya ni Jesus, ginsiring hiya, “Babaye, talwas ka na han imo sakit!”
en: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, “Woman, you are set free from your infirmity.”

war: Idinuon ni Jesus an iya mga kamot ha iya, ngan nakatadong hiya dayon, ngan nagdayaw hiya han Dyos.
en: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.

war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Ano an akon itatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?
en: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?

war: Nagpakiana liwat hi Jesus, “Ano an akon itatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?
en: Again he asked, “What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?

war: Naglatas hi Jesus ha mga bungto ngan mga baryo, ngan nagtutdo samtang tipakadto hiya ha Jerusalem.
en: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.

war: May nagpakiana ha iya, “Tinuod ba nga gutiay la an matatalwas?” Ginbaton hira ni Jesus,
en: Someone asked him, “Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?” He said to them,

war: Onina mabaton kamo, ‘Nagsasaro ngani kita, ngan nagtutdo ka ngani didto han amon bungto!’
en: “Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’

war: Onina may mauuna nga nauorhe yana, ngan may mauorhe nga nauuna yana.”
en: Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last.”

war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in tawo nga nanhuhubag an mga bitiis ngan mga butkon.
en: There in front of him was a man suffering from abnormal swelling of his body.

war: Kundi waray hira pag-aringasa. Kinaptan ni Jesus an tawo, gintambal, ngan ginpalakat hiya.
en: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him on his way.

war: Kundi waray hira makabaton ha iya hiunong hini.
en: And they had nothing to say.

war: Kay adton nagpapadako han iya kalugaringon pauubson; ngan adton magpaubos han iya kalugaringon padadakoon.”
en: For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.”

war: Kundi, kon mananagtawo ka asay lugod dapita an mga kablas, an mga lulid, an mga piay, ngan an mga buta.
en: But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,

war: Ngan magmamalipayon ka, kay diri man hira makakabalos ha imo. Babaloson ka han Dyos kon mabanhaw na an mag-upay nga mga tawo.”
en: and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “May-ada hadto tawo nga nagdapit hin damo nga mga tawo ngadto han iya dako nga kombite.
en: Jesus replied: “A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.

war: Nagsiring in lain pa, ‘Bag-o pa la ako nga nakaasawa, ngan tungod hini, diri ako makakakadto.’
en: “Still another said, ‘I just got married, so I can’t come.’

war: Waray pag-iha nagsiring an surugoon, ‘Natuman na an imo sugo, kundi may mga tarangkaan pa.’
en: “ ‘Sir,’ the servant said, ‘what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.’

war: Susumatan ko kamo ngatanan, nga waray hadton mga dinapit makakatilaw han akon panagtawo!’”
en: I tell you, not one of those who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.’ ”

war: Binmunyog kan Jesus in damo gud nga mga tawo. Inatubang hira ni Jesus ngan sidngon,
en: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:

war: Diri mahihimo nga akon tinun-an an bisan hin-o nga diri magpas-an han iya kalugaringon nga kros ngan sumunod ha akon.
en: And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

war: Masiring hira, ‘Maupay la ini nga tawo hin pagtikang, diri ngay-an maaram hin paghuman!’
en: saying, ‘This person began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

war: “Maupay an asin, kundi kon magmatab-ang na, waray nagud paagi nga mahibalik an iya kapag-ad.
en: “Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

war: Usa ka panahon hinmarani hin pamati kan Jesus in damo nga mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga makasasala.
en: Now the tax collectors and sinners were all gathering around to hear Jesus.

war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hini nga pananglitan:
en: Then Jesus told them this parable:

war: Kon hiagian na ini niya, malipayon na hiya, ngan papas-anon ini niya,
en: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring, “May hadto usa ka tawo nga may-ada duha nga anak nga lalake.
en: Jesus continued: “There was a man who had two sons.

war: Mabangon ako ngan makadto han akon tatay ngan masiring, “Tatay, nakasala ako han Dyos ngan ha imo.
en: I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

war: Diri na ako takos nga isipon pa nga imo anak. Isipa na la ako nga usa han imo mga surugoon.” ’
en: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired servants.’

war: Katapos, kuhaa ngan ihawa niyo an pinatambok nga nati nga baka, ngan pagkombite kita!
en: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let’s have a feast and celebrate.

war: Gintawag niya in usa han mga surugoon ngan nagpakiana ha iya, ‘Ano ini nga rugyaw?’
en: So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.

war: Nagbaton ha iya an amay, ‘Anak ko, dayuday ko ikaw nga kaupod dinhe, ngan imo an ngatanan nga akon mga butang.
en: “ ‘My son,’ the father said, ‘you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

war: Sanglit kon diri ka kasarigan hin pagdumara hin manggad nga kalibutanon, uunanhon hin pagtapori ha imo hin matuod nga manggad?
en: So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?

war: Ngan kon diri ka kasarigan han mga butang hin iba, hin-o man in mahatag ha imo han imo kalugaringon nga mga butang?
en: And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else’s property, who will give you property of your own?

war: Hinbatian han mga Parisiyo ini ngatanan, ngan gintinawaan la nira hi Jesus, kay makisalapi hira.
en: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.

war: Kundi masarusayon pa an pagpapas han langit ngan han tuna kay han pagkawara han gigugutiayi nga bahin han Balaod.
en: It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.

war: Nagsiring an riko, ‘Amay, kon amo man ito, nakikimalooy ako ha imo nga sugoon mo hi Lazaro ngadto ha balay han akon amay,
en: “He answered, ‘Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my family,

war: Pagbantay gud kamo! “Kon makasala an imo bugto, sawaya hiya; ngan kon magbasol hiya, pasayloa.
en: So watch yourselves. “If your brother or sister sins against you, rebuke them; and if they repent, forgive them.

war: Nagsiring ha Ginoo an mga apostol, “Dugangi gad an amon pagtoo.”
en: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”

war: Diri angay an surugoon nga magpasalamat tungod han iya pagsugot, di ba?
en: Will he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?

war: Han tipakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem, nag-agi hiya ha pag-ultan han Samaria ug Galilea.
en: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

war: Tipakadto hiya hin usa nga baryo nga tapoon hiya hin napulo nga mga sanlahon. Tay-aw la ini hira.
en: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance

war: Naggoliat hira hin pagsiring, “Jesus! Agaron! Kalooyi gad kami!”
en: and called out in a loud voice, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”

war: Usa ha ira, han pakakita nga upay na hiya, binmalik nga nagdadayaw han Dyos hin dako nga tingog.
en: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.

war: Hinmapa hiya ha tiilan ni Jesus hin pagpasalamat ha iya. Usa hiya nga Samaritano.
en: He threw himself at Jesus’ feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.

war: Nagyakan hi Jesus, “Napulo man adto hira nga nagkalilinisan; hain naman an siyam?
en: Jesus asked, “Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?

war: Kay ano nga ini la nga diri dinhianon an binmalik hin pagpasalamat han Dyos?”
en: Has no one returned to give praise to God except this foreigner?”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Buhat ngan lakat. An imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.”
en: Then he said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well.”

war: Waray masiring, ‘Kitaa, hahani na!’ o ‘Aadto na!’ kay aada ha sakob niyo an Ginhadian han Dyos.”
en: nor will people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is,’ because the kingdom of God is in your midst.”

war: May-ada ha ira masiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, aadto didto!’ o, ‘Kitaa, aadi didi!’ Kundi ayaw kamo pagkadto hin pamiling hito.
en: People will tell you, ‘There he is!’ or ‘Here he is!’ Do not go running off after them.

war: Kundi kinahanglan mag-antos hiya anay ngan igsalikway han mga tawo hini nga panahon.
en: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

war: Sugad an nahinabo han panahon ni Noe amo man an mahinanabo kon umabot na an Anak han Tawo.
en: “Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.

war: Ha adlaw han paggawas ni Lot ha Sodoma, inmuran hin kalayo ug asupre tikang ha langit, nga amo an nakamatay ha ira ngatanan.
en: But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

war: Amo liwat ini an mahinanabo kon magpadayag na an Anak han Tawo.
en: “It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

war: Hinumdomi niyo an asawa ni Lot!
en: Remember Lot’s wife!

war: Susumatan ko kamo: hito nga gab-i, makaturog in duha ka tawo ha usa nga higdaan kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.
en: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.

war: Magbubulig hin paggiling in duha nga babaye; kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.”
en: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left.”

war: “May-ada hadto usa nga maghurukom hin usa nga bungto, nga waray pagkahadlok han Dyos ngan waray pagtahod han mga tawo.
en: He said: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared what people thought.

war: Ngan nagpadayon an Ginoo, “Paghunahunaa daw an iginsiring hadto nga maraot nga maghurukom.
en: And the Lord said, “Listen to what the unjust judge says.

war: “Kinmadto ha Templo hin pag-ampo in duha ka tawo; Parisiyo an usa, ngan parasukot hin buhis an ikaduha.
en: “Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

war: Nagpupuasa ako duha ka adlaw kada semana, ngan nahatag ako ha imo han ikanapulo nga bahin han ngatanan ko nga hiagi.’
en: I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.’

war: Nagpakiana man hi Jesus, “Kay ano hin pagtawga mo ha akon nga maupay? Waray iba nga maupay labot han Dyos.
en: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.

war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Gintuman ko na ini ngatanan nga mga sugo tikang pa han akon kabata.”
en: “All these I have kept since I was a boy,” he said.

war: Kundi han pakabati niya hini, duro an iya kasubo, kay riko hiya hin duro.
en: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was very wealthy.

war: Nagpakiana an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha iya, “Kon amo ini, hin-o man ngay-an in matatalwas?”
en: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”

war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Nahihimo han Dyos an diri nahihimo han mga tawo.”
en: Jesus replied, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Kitaa! Ginbayaan na namon an amon mga panimalay ha pagsunod ha imo.”
en: Peter said to him, “We have left all we had to follow you!”

war: Itutubyan hiya ha mga Hentil nga magbibiaybiay ha iya, magyuyubit, ngan maglulura ha iya.
en: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him and spit on him;

war: Paglalatobon ngan pagpapatayon hiya nira, kundi mababanhaw hiya ha ikatulo ka adlaw.”
en: they will flog him and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

war: Tikahirani na hi Jesus ha Jerico, ngan nakada ha ligid han dalan in usa nga buta nga nalingkod hin pakilimos.
en: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

war: Han pakabati niya han kadam-an nga nalabay, nagpakiana hiya, “Ano ba ini?”
en: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.

war: Ginsumatan hiya nga nalabay hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.
en: They told him, “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by.”

war: Naggoliat hiya, “Jesus! Anak ni David! Kalooyi gad ako!”
en: He called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

war: Sanglit inmukoy hi Jesus ngan nagsugo nga dad-on an buta ngada ha iya. Han pagdaop na han buta, nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya,
en: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,

war: “Ano an imo karuyag nga buhaton ko ha imo?” Nagbaton hiya, “Karuyag ko nga makakita na liwat ako.”
en: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see,” he replied.

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Makakakita ka na! An imo pagtoo amo an nakaupay ha imo.”

war: Niyan gindara hira niya ha gawas han syudad tubtob ha Betania diin gin-alsa niya an iya mga kamot ngan ginbendisyonan hira.
en: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

war: Samtang nagbebendisyon hiya ha ira, binmaya hiya ha ira ngan ginbayaw hiya ha langit.
en: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

war: Nagsingba hira ha iya ngan binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem, nga malipayon,
en: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

war: ngan dayuday didto hira ha Templo, hin pagpasalamat han Dyos.
en: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.

war: Amo ini an pagkasunodsunod han mga kaapoy-apoyan ni Jesu-Cristo nga tulin ni David, nga tulin ni Abraham.
en: This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham:

war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan basi matuman an iginyakan han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna nga nasiring,
en: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

war: Han pakabati hini ni Hadi Herodes, nabaraka hiya pati an bug-os nga Jerusalem.
en: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

war: “Didto ha bungto han Betlehem, ha Judea,” nagbaton hira. “Amo ini an iginsurat han manaragna:
en: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:

war: Binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy, ngan pinmalagiw hira ngadto ha Ehipto hadto ngahaw nga gab-i.
en: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,

war: Dida hini natuman an iginsurat ni Jeremias nga manaragna nga nasiring:
en: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan inmoli ngadto ha Israel.
en: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.

war: Hadto nga panahon hi Juan nga Parabunyag kinmadto ha kamingawan han Judea ngan nagtikang hin pagwali.
en: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

war: Nagsiring hiya, “Magbasol ngan bayai an iyo mga sala kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit.”
en: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”

war: Iginkumpisal nira an ira mga sala ngan ginbunyagan hira ni Juan didto ha Salog Jordan.
en: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

war: Ipakita ha iyo mga buhat nga nagbasol na kamo han iyo mga sala.
en: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.

war: Hadto nga panahon, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Galilea, ngan kinmadto kan Juan didto ha Jordan basi bunyagan hiya ni Juan.
en: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

war: Ngan nagsiring in tingog tikang ha langit, “Amo ini an akon hinigugma nga Anak nga nakakalipay gud ha akon.”
en: And a voice from heaven said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.”

war: Niyan gindara hi Jesus han Espiritu ngadto han kamingawan basi pagsulayon han Yawa.
en: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

war: Katapos hin 40 ka adlaw ngan 40 ka gab-i nga pagpuasa, ginutom hi Jesus.
en: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.

war: Dinmaop ha iya an Yawa ngan nagsiring, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, himoa nga tinapay ini nga mga bato.”
en: The tempter came to him and said, “If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto han Baraan nga Syudad, ngan ibinutang hiya didto han gihahataasi nga atop han Templo,
en: Then the devil took him to the holy city and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kundi nasiring man liwat an kasuratan, ‘Kinahanglan diri mo pagsulayon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos.’”
en: Jesus answered him, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’ ”

war: “Ihahatag ko ha imo ini ngatanan,” nagsiring an Yawa, “kon humapa ka ngan magsingba ka ha akon.”
en: “All this I will give you,” he said, “if you will bow down and worship me.”

war: Ngan binmaya an Yawa kan Jesus, ngan nagkaabot in mga anghel ug nagtimangno kan Jesus.
en: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.

war: Han pakabati ni Jesus nga napriso hi Juan, kinmadto hiya ha Galilea.
en: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he withdrew to Galilee.

war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna nga nasiring:
en: to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:

war: “Galilea han mga Hentil! An tuna ha Zabulon ngan an tuna ha Neftali, aragian tipakadto ha dagat, ha tabok han Jordan.
en: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—

war: Tikang hadto nagtikang hi Jesus hin pagwali, “Bayai niyo an iyo mga sala, kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit!”
en: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”

war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Upod kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ko kamo pagdakop hin mga tawo.”
en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

war: Ira binayaan dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira ha iya.
en: At once they left their nets and followed him.

war: Dida dayon binayaan nira an sakayan ngan an ira amay, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.
en: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

war: ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira:
en: and he began to teach them. He said:

war: “Palaran adton nakilala nga kablas hira ha espiritu, kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!
en: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

war: “Palaran adton masulob-on, kay pagliliawon hira han Dyos!
en: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

war: “Palaran adton mapinaubsanon, kay kakarawaton nira an iginsaad han Dyos!
en: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

war: “Palaran adton may dako nga tinguha pagtuman han kaburut-on han Dyos, kay patutungahon gud hira han Dyos!
en: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

war: “Palaran adton maloloy-on ha iba, kay malolooy man an Dyos ha ira!
en: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

war: “Palaran adton maglinis in kasingkasing, kay makakakita hira han Dyos!
en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

war: “Palaran adton nagbubuhat para hin kamurayaw ha mga tawo, kay tatawgon hira nga mga anak han Dyos!
en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

war: “Palaran adton ginpapakurian tungod nga nagtutuman hira han kaburut-on han Dyos, kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!
en: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

war: “Kamo amo an kapawa han bug-os nga kalibutan. Diri matatago in bungto nga gintindog ha bawbaw hin bukid.
en: “You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

war: Nasiring ako ha imo: diri ka makakagawas didto tubtob nga kabaydan mo an ngatanan nga multa ha imo.
en: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring ini, ‘Diri ka manlibog.’
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’

war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagsumpa kon nagsasaad ka. Ayaw gamita an langit hin pagsumpa, kay trono ito han Dyos;
en: But I tell you, do not swear an oath at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;

war: Ayaw gamita bisan pa an imo ulo, kay diri ka makakapabusag o makakapaitom hin usa han imo buhok.
en: And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make even one hair white or black.

war: Igo na nga masiring ka, ‘Oo’ kon matangdo ka; ‘Diri’ kon mariwa ka; natikang na han Yawa an sobra pa hini nga igyayakan mo.
en: All you need to say is simply ‘Yes’ or ‘No’; anything beyond this comes from the evil one.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘An mata bayaran hin mata ngan an ngipon bayaran hin ngipon.’
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.’

war: Ngan kon may magsumbong ha imo basi makuha niya an imo kamiseta, ihatag pa ha iya pati an imo kamisadentro.
en: And if anyone wants to sue you and take your shirt, hand over your coat as well.

war: Kon in sondalo magpirit ha imo hin pagdara han iya kasangkapan sulod hin usa ka kilometro, dad-a ito hin duha ka kilometro.
en: If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.

war: Tagi kon may mangaro ha imo, ngan pahudma kon may humoram ha imo.
en: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.

war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘Higugmaa an iyo kasangkayan, pagdumti an iyo mga kaaway.’
en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: higugmaa an iyo mga kaaway ngan ig-ampo an mga nagpapakuri ha iyo,
en: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

war: Sanglit kinahanglan mahingpit kamo, sugad nga hingpit an iyo Amay ha langit.
en: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

war: basi mahilom an iyo paghatag, ngan babaloson kamo han Amay niyo nga nakita han maupay nga ginbubuhat niyo hin hilom.
en: so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

war: Sanglit sugara hini an iyo pag-ampo: ‘Amay namon ha langit: Pagdayawon an imo baraan nga ngaran,
en: “This, then, is how you should pray: “ ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name,

war: Maghadi ka unta ha amon, matuman dinhe ha tuna an imo kaburut-on sugad han didto ha langit.
en: your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

war: Tagi kami yana nga adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.
en: Give us today our daily bread.

war: Pasayloa kami han amon mga sala sugad han pagpasaylo namon han mga nakasala ha amon.
en: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

war: “Kon pasayloon niyo an nakakasala ha iyo, pasasayloon man kamo han Amay niyo ha langit.
en: For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

war: Kon magpupuasa kamo, paghiram-os ngan pagsudlay,
en: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,

war: Kay kon hain an iyo mga manggad, dayuday aadto man an iyo kasingkasing.
en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

war: “An mga mata amo an suga para han lawas. Kon maupay an iyo mga mata, malulukop hin kapawa an bug-os niyo nga lawas.
en: “The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakapahilaba han iya kinabuhi hin bisan pira la ka tuig pinaagi han iyo pagkinabaraka?
en: Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life ?

war: “Sanglit ayaw kamo kabaraka han iyo kakaonon, iimnon, o igpapanapton.
en: So do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’

war: “Ayaw kamo paghukom han iba basi diri kamo paghukman han Dyos.
en: “Do not judge, or you too will be judged.

war: “Pangaro ngan tatagan kamo; pamiling ngan makakaagi kamo; pagtuktok ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iyo.
en: “Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.

war: Kay makarawat an tagsa nga nangangaro, makakaagi an namimiling, ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iya nga nagtutuktok.
en: For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

war: Kamo nga mga amay, tatagan ba niyo hin bato kon mangaro an iyo anak hin tinapay?
en: “Which of you, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

war: Tatagan ba niyo hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?
en: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?

war: Kundi haligot an aragian ngan makuri an dalan tipakadto ha kinabuhi nga dayon, ngan diri damo an nakakatoltol hini nga dalan.
en: But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.

war: Makikilala niyo hira pinaagi han ira mga panggawi. Binuburo ba in ubas tikang hin kasapinitan, o in igos tikang hin niyutiyo?
en: By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

war: Nabunga hin maupay an maupay nga kahoy, kundi nabunga hin maraot an maraot man nga kahoy.
en: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.

war: Diri makakabunga hin maraot an maupay nga kahoy, diri man liwat makakabunga hin maupay an maraot nga kahoy.
en: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.

war: Pupudlon ngan susunogon an kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.
en: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

war: Sanglit, makikilala niyo an buwaon nga mga manaragna pinaagi han ira mga panggawi.
en: Thus, by their fruit you will recognize them.

war: Katapos ni Jesus pagyakan hini nga mga butang, nahipausa an mga tawo han paagi han iya pagtutdo,
en: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,

war: kay nagtutdo hiya nga may gahom ngan diri sugad han ira mga magturutdo han Balaod.
en: because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.

war: Linmugsong hi Jesus tikang hin pungtod ngan nagsunod ha iya in damo kaupay nga mga tawo.
en: When Jesus came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.

war: Han pagsulod ni Jesus ha Capernaum gintapo hiya hin kapitan nga Romano nga nakimalooy ha iya,
en: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking for help.

war: “Sir, masakit an akon surugoon, nahigda, diri nakakakiwa, ngan nagkukuri hin duro.”
en: “Lord,” he said, “my servant lies at home paralyzed, suffering terribly.”

war: “Makadto ako ngan uupayon ko hiya,” nagsiring hi Jesus.
en: Jesus said to him, “Shall I come and heal him?”

war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha balay ni Pedro ngan hinkit-an niya an babaye nga ugangan ni Pedro nga nahigda kay hinihirantan.
en: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.

war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an iya kamot ngan nalungasan hiya han hiranat. Binmuhat hiya ngan nagsirbe kan Jesus.
en: He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.

war: Han pagkita ni Jesus han kadam-an nga nag-aalirong ha iya, nagsugo hiya han iya mga tinun-an nga mapakadto ha tabok han lanaw.
en: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the lake.

war: Dinimaop ha iya in usa nga magturutdo han Balaod ngan nagsiring, “Magturutdo, andam ako hin pag-upod ha imo bisan ngain.”
en: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

war: Nagsiring liwat in lain nga tinun-an, “Tugoti gad ako hin pag-oli anay hin paglubong han akon amay.”
en: Another disciple said to him, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

war: Kundi ginbaton hiya ni Jesus, “Sunod ha akon, ngan pabay-i an mga patay nga asay maglubong han ira minatay.”
en: But Jesus told him, “Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

war: Sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.
en: Then he got into the boat and his disciples followed him.

war: Gindaop hiya han mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring hin pagpukaw ha iya, “Talwasa kami, Ginoo! Malulunod kita!”
en: The disciples went and woke him, saying, “Lord, save us! We’re going to drown!”

war: May dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon hirani hini nga dapit.
en: Some distance from them a large herd of pigs was feeding.

war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga yawa, “Kon pagagawson mo man kami, pasudla kami ngadto hito nga panon hin kababoyan.”
en: The demons begged Jesus, “If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

war: Sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan, binmalik pagtabok han lanaw, ngan kinmadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto.
en: Jesus stepped into a boat, crossed over and came to his own town.

war: Ngan may hinsiring hin pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Nagpanamastamas ini nga tawo!”
en: At this, some of the teachers of the law said to themselves, “This fellow is blaspheming!”

war: Hain in masarusayon, an pagsiring, ‘An imo mga sala ginpasaylo,’ o an pagsiring, ‘Buhat ngan lakat’?
en: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?

war: Binmuhat an tawo ngan inmoli.
en: Then the man got up and went home.

war: Sanglit, binmuhat hi Jesus ngan sinmunod ha iya ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.
en: Jesus got up and went with him, and so did his disciples.

war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya kalugaringon, “Kon makakamkam la ako han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”
en: She said to herself, “If I only touch his cloak, I will be healed.”

war: nagsiring hiya, “Kagawas kamo ngatanan! Diri patay an bata; nakaturog la hiya!” Ngan gintinawaan hiya nira.
en: he said, “Go away. The girl is not dead but asleep.” But they laughed at him.

war: Ngan nahisangyaw ini nga nahinabo ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hito nga tuna.
en: News of this spread through all that region.

war: Niyan kinamkam ni Jesus an ira mga mata ngan nagsiring, “Mahimo unta sumala gud han iyo pagtoo!”—
en: Then he touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith let it be done to you”;

war: Kundi linmakat hira ngan iginsumat lugod nira ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hadto nga tuna an ginbuhat ha ira ni Jesus.
en: But they went out and spread the news about him all over that region.

war: Kundi nagsiring an mga Parisiyo, “An punoan han mga yawa an naghatag ha iya hin gahom hin pagpagawas han mga yawa.”
en: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that he drives out demons.”

war: Sanglit ginsiring niya an iya mga tinun-an, “Damo in aranihon kundi gutiay la in mga mag-arani.
en: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest is plentiful but the workers are few.

war: Pag-ampo kamo han tag-ada han aranihon nga padad-an niya hin mga mag-arani nga magtitirok han ira gin-ani.”
en: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.”

war: hi Felipe ngan hi Bartolome; hi Tomas ngan hi Mateo nga parasukot hin buhis; hi Santiago, nga anak ni Alfeo, ngan hi Tadeo;
en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

war: hi Simon nga bayani, ngan hi Judas Iscariote nga naglingo kan Jesus.
en: Simon the Zealot and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.

war: Lugod, kadtoa niyo an nagkawawara nga mga karnero han katawhan han Israel.
en: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.

war: Lakat kamo ngan ipasangyaw nga hirani na an Ginhadian han langit.
en: As you go, proclaim this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven has come near.’

war: Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bulawan, salapi, o bronse nga kwarta ha iyo mga bulsa;
en: “Do not get any gold or silver or copper to take with you in your belts—

war: Pagsaka niyo hin balay siring kamo, ‘Maada unta ha iyo an kamurayaw.’
en: As you enter the home, give it your greeting.

war: Kay diri iyo an mga pulong nga igyayakan niyo, kundi tikang han Espiritu han Amay niyo nga magyayakan ha iyo.
en: for it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

war: Pagdudumtan kamo han ngatanan tungod ha akon, kundi matatalwas an magpailob tubtob ha kataposan.
en: You will be hated by everyone because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.

war: “Waray tinun-an nga labaw han iya magturutdo; waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron.
en: “The student is not above the teacher, nor a servant above his master.

war: An ha iyo nga bahin, gin-ihap na bisan ngani an ngatanan nga mga buhok han iyo ulo.
en: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

war: Sanglit ayaw kamo kahadlok; mahal pa kamo kaupay kay hin damo nga mga balinsasayaw!
en: So don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

war: “Aangkonon ko man ha atubangan han akon Amay ha langit an bisan hin-o nga magpadayag ha kadam-an nga akon hiya.
en: “Whoever acknowledges me before others, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

war: Kundi iglilirong ko man ha atubangan han akon Amay ha langit an bisan hin-o nga maglirong ha kadam-an nga akon hiya.
en: But whoever disowns me before others, I will disown before my Father in heaven.

war: An makaharadlok gud nga mga kaaway han tawo amo an mga sakop ngahaw han iya kalugaringon nga panimalay.
en: a man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’

war: Diri takos ha akon an diri magpas-an han iya kros ngan diri magsunod ha akon.
en: Whoever does not take up their cross and follow me is not worthy of me.

war: An karuyag magtipig han iya kinabuhi ini mawawara ha iya; kundi an kawad-an han iya kinabuhi tungod ha akon mabubuhi lugod.
en: Whoever finds their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.

war: Nagpakiana hira kan Jesus, “Sumati daw kami, ikaw ba an ginpapaabot nga ginsiring ni Juan, o maghuhulat pa ba kami hin lain?”
en: to ask him, “Are you the one who is to come, or should we expect someone else?”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Balik kamo ngan sumati hi Juan han iyo hinbabatian ngan hinkikit-an:
en: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:

war: Hin kapalaran hadton waray pagruhaduha ha akon!”
en: Blessed is anyone who does not stumble on account of me.”

war: Ngada han panahon ni Juan, naghimangraw mahitungod han Ginhadian an ngatanan nga mga manaragna ngan an Balaod ni Moises;
en: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

war: ngan kon karuyag niyo hin pagtoo han ira sumat, hi Juan amo hi Elias kanay pag-abot daan na igintagna.
en: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.

war: Sanglit, pamati kamo kon may niyo mga durunggan!
en: Whoever has ears, let them hear.

war: Han pagkanhi ni Juan, nagpuasa hiya, ngan waray uminom hin bino, ngan nagsiring an ngatanan, ‘May-ada yawa dida ha iya!’
en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

war: Sanglit, hinumdomi nga ha Adlaw han Paghukom, labaw pa nga malolooy an Dyos han mga tawo han Tiro ug Sidon kay ha iyo!
en: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

war: Sanglit, hinumdomi nga ha Adlaw han Paghukom, labaw pa nga malolooy an Dyos han Sodoma kay ha imo!”
en: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”

war: Tinuod, Amay ko, nahimo ini tungod han imo kalugaringon nga pagbuot ug karuyag.
en: Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.

war: Kay masayon an yugo nga ihinahatag ko ha iyo, ngan magaanay an darad-on nga ipapapas-an ko ha iyo.”

war: Sanglit padayona ngan taposa niyo an gintikangan han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan!

war: Kundi matatalwas an magpadayon tubtob ha kataposan.

en: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

war: “Niyan kon may magsiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, iini na an Mesiyas!’ o ‘Aadto hiya didto!’—ayaw kamo tuod ha iya.

war: Tigamni niyo: daan ko na kamo ginpasidaanan hini.

en: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.

en: Then Pilate asked him, “Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”

war: Kundi waray gud hi Jesus magbaton bisan na man la usa ka pulong, sanglit duro gud an paghipausa han gobernador.
en: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.

war: Hadto nga panahon may kilala kaupay nga preso nga Jesus Barabas an ngaran.
en: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.

war: Nasayod hi Pilato nga igintubyan nira hi Jesus ha iya tungod la hin kaawa.
en: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.

war: Binmaton an ngatanan nga mga tawo, “Kami ngan han amon mga anak an mabaton han kamatayon hini nga tawo!”
en: All the people answered, “His blood is on us and on our children!”

war: Niyan ginbuhian ni Pilato hi Barabas, iginpalatob niya hi Jesus, ngan igintubyan hiya ha ira basi igraysang ha kros.
en: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

war: Ginlubasan hiya han iya panapton ngan ginsul-otan hiya hin hilawig nga pula nga bado.
en: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

war: Ginludhan hiya ngan kinuha nira an sipak han iya kamot ngan ginbalbag an iya ulo.
en: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

war: Inmabot hira ha usa nga dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Golgota, nga an kahulogan, “An Dapit han Klabera.”
en: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).

war: Didto gintagan nira hi Jesus hin bino nga sinaktan hin apdo basi niya imnon. Kundi han pakatilaw ni Jesus, waray hiya uminom.
en: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.

war: Niyan iginraysang hiya nira ha kros ngan ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa.
en: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

war: Pagkatapos, linmingkod hira ngan ginbantayan nira hiya.
en: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.

war: Iginpaskin nira ha igbaw han iya ulo an sinurat nga sumbong kontra ha iya: “Amo ini hi Jesus, an hadi han mga Judiyo.”
en: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews .

war: Ngan iginraysang liwat nira ha kros in duha nga mga tulisan upod kan Jesus, an usa ha iya tuo ngan an usa ha iya wala.
en: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

war: An mga tawo nga nangangagi nagpilingpiling han ira ulo ngan nagyubit kan Jesus hin pagsiring,
en: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads

war: Bisan pa ngani an mga tulisan nga iginraysang upod ha iya nagbiaybiay ha iya.
en: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.

war: Han pagka-udto, nagsirom an bug-os nga tuna sulod hin tulo ka oras.
en: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.

war: Nakabati ha iya an iba nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto ngan nagsiring hira, “Nagtatawag hiya kan Elias!”
en: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He’s calling Elijah.”

war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hulat anay, kikitaon ta kon kumanhi manggud hi Elias hin pagtalwas ha iya!”
en: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him.”

war: Hin makusog nga tingog ginmuliat hi Jesus, ngan nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.
en: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

war: nagkaabre an mga lubnganan, ngan damo nga mga patay na nga magtinuohon han Dyos an nabanhaw.
en: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

war: Damo in kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Nagsinunod ini hira kan Jesus tikang pa ha Galilea, ngan nagbulig ha iya.
en: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.

war: Nakigkita hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus. Nagsugo hi Pilato nga ihatag an lawas kan Jose.
en: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

war: Sanglit gindara ni Jose an lawas ngan ginputos hin bag-o nga taklap nga lino.
en: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

war: Nakadto hira Maria Magdalena ngan an usa pa nga Maria, nalingkod ha atubangan han lubnganan.
en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuha kamo hin magbarantay ngan pabantayi ha iya hin maupay an lubnganan.”
en: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”

war: Sugad hin kikidlat an iya dagway, ngan duro kamabusag an iya panapton.
en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

war: Duro an pangurog tungod hin kahadlok an mga bantay, ngan waray hira makakiwa, sugad hira hin mga patay.
en: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

war: Waray hiya dinhe; nabanhaw hiya sugad han siring niya. Kadi ngan kitaa niyo an dapit nga ginhigdaan niya.
en: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

war: Ngan kon makabati hini an Gobernador, kami na an labi nga maaram hin pagbaton ha iya ngan waray niyo sadang kabarak-an.”
en: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”

war: Kinmadto ha Galilea an onse nga mga tinun-an, ha bukid nga ginpakadtoan ha ira ni Jesus.
en: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.

war: Han pakakita nira ha iya, ginsingba hiya nira, bisan kon may-ada ha ira nagruhaduha.
en: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.

war: Hinmarani hi Jesus ngan ginsiring hira, “Iginhatag ha akon an ngatanan nga gahom ha langit ngan ha tuna.
en: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

war: Amo ini an Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesu-Cristo nga Anak han Dyos.
en: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,

war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, kundi magbubunyag hiya ha iyo han Espiritu Santo.”
en: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”

war: Hinbatian in tingog tikang ha langit nga nasiring, “Ikaw an akon hinigugma nga Anak. Nalilipay gud ako ha imo.”
en: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”

war: Ha gilayon hi Jesus ginpakadto han Espiritu ha kamingawan.
en: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,

war: Han kabilanggo ni Juan, kinmadto hi Jesus ha Galilea ngan nagwali hiya didto han Maupay nga Sumat tikang sa Dyos.
en: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Bunyog kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ta kamo hin pangisda hin mga tawo.”
en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”

war: Binayaan nira dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.
en: At once they left their nets and followed him.

war: Hito nga takna, sinmakob han sinagoga in tawo nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan ginmoliat,
en: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,

en: “Be quiet!” said Jesus sternly. “Come out of him!”

war: Binuntog an tawo, ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog, ngan ginmawas an maraot nga espiritu dida ha iya.
en: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.

war: Nahisangyaw dayon ha bisan diin nga dapit han katunaan ha Galilea ini nga hinabo nga ginbuhat ni Jesus.
en: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.

war: Nahigda an ugangan nga babaye ni Simon kay hinihirantan. Pag-abot ni Jesus, ginsumatan hiya mahitungod hini nga masakit.

war: Sanglit nagsudoy hiya han bug-os nga Galilea, nagwali hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagpagawas hiya hin mga yawa.
en: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha iya. Gindun-an hiya ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko. Magmalinis ka!”

war: Nakuha dayon an sanla ngan naupay an tawo.

en: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.

war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira dako nga pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Anak, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”
en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

en: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the man,

war: “Nasiring ako ha imo, buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan uli ha iyo balay!”
en: “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha baybayon han Lanaw Galilea. Dinmaop in mga tawo ha iya ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira.
en: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal; ngan amo na an ira diri pagkaon.
en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.

war: Nagsiring an mga Parisiyo kan Jesus, “Diri tugot han aton Balaod nga mangutos an imo mga tinun-an ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”
en: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginhimo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway tungod han tawo; diri an tawo tungod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.
en: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

war: Sanglit an Anak han Tawo Ginoo bisan han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”
en: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”

war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha sinagoga diin nakadto in tawo nga patay an kamot.
en: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.

en: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Stand up in front of everyone.”

en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.

war: Kon magkabahinbahin in usa nga nasod ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mapupukan ito nga nasod.
en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

war: Kon makabahinbahin in usa nga panimalay ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mabubungkag ito nga panimalay.
en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

war: Sanglit kon magkabahinbahin an ginhadian ni Satanas, diri ito mag-iiha, kundi mabubungkag ngan mapupukan.
en: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.

en: He said this because they were saying, “He has an impure spirit.”

war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Hin-o an akon iroy? Hin-o an akon kabugtoan?”
en: “Who are my mother and my brothers?” he asked.

war: Akon kabugtoan ngan akon iroy an bisan hin-o nga nagtutuman han iginpapabuhat ha iya han Dyos.”
en: Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”

war: Damo an igintutdo niya pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Dida han iya pagtutdo nagsiring hiya ha ira:
en: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:

war: “Pamati kamo! May-ada tawo nga kinmadto han iya uma hin pagsabod.
en: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.

war: Han nagsasabod hiya, may mga binhe nga nagkataktak ha dalan ngan pinanuktok han mga tamsi.
en: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

war: May-ada nahulog ngada hin batoon nga tuna. Tinmurok gad an binhe kay may-ada man manipis nga tuna.
en: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.

war: Kundi han pagsirak han adlaw, nalaya an mga tanom kay waray makagamot hin maupay, ngan nagkauuga.
en: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon hin-o ha iyo an may durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”
en: Then Jesus said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”

war: An magsarabod nagsabod han mensahe han Dyos.
en: The farmer sows the word.

war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod dida hin tunokon nga kabanwaan. Nakakabati ini hira han mensahe,
en: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;

war: Ipadadayag an natatago; bubuksan an natatahoban.
en: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.

war: Kon hin-o an may mga durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”
en: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”

war: Tatagan pa adton may-ada na; kukuhaan adton waray, bisan han gutiay nga aada ha iya.”
en: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”

war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring: “Alid-agid an Ginhadian han Dyos hin tawo nga nagsabod hin binhe ha iya uma.
en: He also said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.

war: An tuna ngahaw an nakakapatubo ngan nakakapabunga: syahan, nananahon; niyan, namumukad; kahuman, namumunga.
en: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.

en: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side.”

war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nahahadlok man kamo? Waray la gihapon kamo pagtoo?”

war: Inmabot hira ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea, didto han tuna han mga taga-Gadara.

en: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.

en: For Jesus had said to him, “Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”

war: Sanglit ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Hin-o an imo ngaran?” Binmaton an tawo, “‘Panon’ an akon ngaran, kay damo kami.”

war: Waray hiya humunong pakimalooy kan Jesus nga diri pagawson an maraot nga mga espiritu dida hito nga tuna.

war: May-ada dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon dida hin hirani nga pungtod.
en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.

war: Naghangyo kan Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, “Pasudla kami ngadto han kababoyan.”

war: Nagsumat han mga tawo adton nakakita kon ano an nahinabo han tawo nga sinangkayan hin yawa ngan han kababoyan.

war: Sanglit ginhangyo nira hi Jesus nga gumawas han ira tuna.

war: Ngan inmupod hi Jesus ha iya. Damo liwat nga mga tawo an binmunyog kan Jesus ngan gindadaisog hiya han mga tawo.

war: May-ada babaye nga makalilisang na an gin-antos tungod hin duro nga pagdinugoi ha iya hin dose na ka tuig,

war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, “Kon makakapot la ako bisan la han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”

war: Kinaptan niya an bado ni Jesus, ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya; inabat niya nga naupay hiya han iya sakit.
en: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.

war: Kundi gin-osisa gud ni Jesus kon hin-o an kinapot han iya bado.
